# US-04 — Design system and visual redesign · Spec

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Story | [story.md](story.md) (English translation of the human's request, not edited; the human confirms the translation at HC1) |
| Status | Approved |
| Version | 0.2 |
| Author | spec-writer subagent (Claude Opus 5.5) |
| Approved by | v0.1: Felipe Sabogal, 2026-11-21 (HC1 round 1). v0.2: applies the ADR-driven adjustments 1–14 and the week-start decision that the human approved at that same HC1 (§13); the further alignments with the accepted ADR-0010..0013 listed in the v0.2 row of §13 are for the human to confirm. |
| Related ADRs | [ADR-0001](../../adr/0001-multi-country-content-strategy.md) (amended by ADR-0006 and [ADR-0011](../../adr/0011-country-visuals-amends-adr-0001.md)), [ADR-0003](../../adr/0003-wizard-state-persistence.md) (stored values unchanged), [ADR-0004](../../adr/0004-forms-library.md) (amended by [ADR-0012](../../adr/0012-accessible-select-and-date-picker.md)), [ADR-0009](../../adr/0009-terms-rich-text-rendering.md) (heading hierarchy), [ADR-0010](../../adr/0010-design-tokens-and-visual-language.md) (tokens and visual language), ADR-0011 (country visuals), ADR-0012 (select and date picker, lazy step 1), [ADR-0013](../../adr/0013-motion-and-reduced-motion.md) (motion and reduced motion). All Accepted; none needed (§10). |

Sources cited in this spec:

- **Story**: [story.md](story.md).
- **US-01** [spec](../US-01/spec.md) v0.5 (Approved): field types, reserved keys, BR-01 (unreadable input is invalid), BR-02 (select prompt), BR-04 (`minAge`), AC-09 note (badInput semantics), AC-10 (error timing, focus), AC-24/25/26, Q-22 (native date input), §8.1 copy, §9 ("Native controls are used"); seed in [seed-fields.md](../US-01/seed-fields.md).
- **US-02** [spec](../US-02/spec.md) and **US-03** [spec](../US-03/spec.md) (Approved): plan cards as native radios, "Recomendado", summary sections, terms region, simulation radio group, focus order (US-02-AC-16, US-03-AC-16), §8.1 copy.
- **Existing tests**: `frontend/e2e/*.spec.ts` (7 files) and `frontend/e2e/support/*.ts`; component tests and helpers in `frontend/src/**` (`testing/dom.ts`, `quote-form-page.spec.ts`, `static-guards.spec.ts`).
- **ADRs** (Accepted at HC2, 2026-11-21): ADR-0010 (tokens, palette, type, icons, flags), ADR-0011
  (country visuals; amends ADR-0001), ADR-0012 (`@angular/aria` + `@angular/cdk`, Signal Forms
  binding, lazy step 1; amends ADR-0004), ADR-0013 (motion). v0.2 applies their *Spec impact*
  sections.
- **Evidence**: [docs/qa/US-04/README.md](../../docs/qa/US-04/README.md) (`before/` set; native popups not capturable).
- **Visual direction** given by the human with the brief (reference screenshot, inspiration only): dark near-black background with a subtle dotted texture; violet/indigo accent; recommended card with a violet vertical gradient and soft glow; rounded cards with thin borders; pill-shaped segmented toggles; check-circle icons in feature lists; large bold display headings with a soft text gradient; high-contrast white primary buttons.

## 1. Summary

A visual redesign of the whole quoting wizard (country chooser, step 1 form, plan list, summary,
payment and confirmation) on a tokenized design system, for people in Colombia and Chile on
phone, tablet and desktop. It adds country flags and a per-country accent, icons, an accessible
custom select and date picker (replacing the browser's native ones), a step indicator, step
transitions, skeletons and micro-animations that all honour `prefers-reduced-motion`, a
mobile-first responsive layout with 44 × 44 px targets, and self-hosted typography. Behaviour,
validation, stored values, routes and the Strapi contracts do not change; the existing tests keep
passing with the same strength, adapted only where a native element is replaced (§11.1).

## 2. Scope

**In scope**

- A token file (primitive → semantic → component) and the restyling of every existing page and
  shared component through tokens only.
- Theme, palette, gradients, dotted background texture, type scale, two font families
  self-hosted (US-04-Q-01, Q-03, Q-08; ADR-0010).
- Flags of CO and CL as SVG on the country chooser and in a new wizard header; per-country accent
  token (US-04-Q-02, Q-10; ADR-0011).
- One icon library (`@lucide/angular` 1.77.0, ADR-0010); icons inside step 1 inputs (by field key,
  with a default), in the step indicator, plan cards (check-circle in coverage and benefit lists),
  help, error and success messages (US-04-Q-09).
- Custom select (with search for long lists) and custom date picker (typed entry, calendar with
  month and year navigation, `minAge`-disabled days), built on `@angular/aria` and `@angular/cdk`
  22.3.0, bound to the existing Signal Forms model (ADR-0004 as amended by ADR-0012), with bottom
  sheet on mobile (US-04-Q-04, Q-05, Q-11, Q-12, Q-13).
- Lazy loading of the step 1 page (`loadComponent` on `/:country/datos`, ADR-0012 §7) so the new
  packages and step 1 icons stay out of the initial bundle; the route address and guards are
  unchanged.
- New interface microcopy owned by the front end (§8.1).
- Step indicator, step enter transition, hover/focus/active/disabled states, soft validation
  feedback, skeletons, interactive plan cards, summary and confirmation micro-animations
  (US-04-Q-14..Q-17).
- `prefers-reduced-motion`, responsive layout at 360 × 740, 768 × 1024 and 1280 × 800.
- Adapting existing tests where a native element is replaced, as listed in §11.1, and new tests.
- After screenshots in `docs/qa/US-04/after/` (US-04-Q-19).

**Out of scope**

- Any change to route addresses (step 1 only becomes lazy-loaded, above), guards, the wizard state, validation rules or messages, prices, masking,
  payment simulation, or the Strapi schema, seed, permissions and proxy (story: "Logic, the
  contracts with Strapi and the texts that come from Strapi do not change").
- Rewriting help texts, placeholders or error messages that come from Strapi (US-04-Q-07).
- A light theme or a theme switch (US-04-Q-01; ADR-0010: dark only).
- An in-wizard country switcher (US-01-Q-02 stands).
- Changing the native `number`, `text`, `checkbox` and `radio` controls into custom widgets; they
  are restyled only.
- Logos, names, slogans or texts of any real insurer or company; a brand name for the product.
- Adoption of the third-party design skills `ui-ux-pro-max`, `impeccable`, `frontend-design`: they
  are evaluated separately (task US-04-T-01; per `tasks.md` *Gate history*, the first two were
  rejected and `frontend-design` adopted with adjustments, CLAUDE.md §5); no requirement of this
  spec depends on any of them.

## 3. Glossary

Terms of the US-01..US-03 glossaries keep their meaning.

| Term | Meaning in this project |
|---|---|
| Token | A CSS custom property declared in the single token file (BR-01). |
| Primitive / semantic / component token | Raw values (`--primitive-violet-400`), roles (`--color-text-muted`, `--space-4`), and per-component bindings (`--component-button-primary-bg`). Prefixes per ADR-0010 §1. Components use semantic or component tokens only. |
| Loose value | A literal colour, length, font, shadow, gradient, duration, easing or z-index in a component style instead of a `var(--…)` (allowed literals in BR-01). |
| Country accent | The per-country accent colour token, set from the current country context (BR-03). |
| Custom select | The design-system replacement for a `select` field: a WAI-ARIA combobox with a listbox popup (BR-05). A **select-only** custom select (fewer than 4 options) has a `<button>` as its combobox element; a **searchable** one has an `<input>` (ADR-0012 §3). |
| Searchable select | A custom select whose option count reaches the search threshold; typing filters the options (US-04-Q-11). |
| Date field | The design-system replacement for a `date` field: a text box for typed entry plus an "Elegir fecha" button that opens the calendar (BR-06). |
| Calendar | The WAI-ARIA date picker dialog opened from the date field. |
| Shown value | What a control displays: the option label of a custom select, the dd/mm/aaaa text of a date field. An empty select-only custom select shows the prompt "Selecciona una opción" as its button text; an empty searchable one shows the prompt as its placeholder, and its input value (`inputValue()`) is `''`. |
| Stored value | The value in the editing model and in the `quote-wizard` entry (ADR-0003, ADR-0004): option `value`, ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `''`. Unchanged by US-04. |
| Panel | The popup of a custom select or the calendar: an anchored popover on wide screens, a bottom sheet below `--breakpoint-sheet` (37.5em, 600 CSS px; US-04-Q-13, ADR-0010 §6). |
| Wizard header | New top bar on the wizard pages with the product name and the country chip (flag + country name). |
| Step indicator | New progress display of the three wizard steps (US-04-Q-17). |

## 4. Business rules

| ID | Original (story) | Refined (precise, testable) | Covered by |
|---|---|---|---|
| US-04-BR-01 | "Tokens as CSS custom properties in a single source file (color, typography, spacing, radii, shadows, gradients, animation durations and easing curves, z-index). Primitive → semantic → component tokens. No loose values in components." | Exactly one file, `frontend/src/styles/tokens.css` (ADR-0010 §1), declares custom properties and `@font-face`, in three tiers with distinct prefixes (`--primitive-`; the semantic prefixes of ADR-0010 §1; `--component-`). Every other style file (`styles.css` and every component `.css`) uses only `var(--…)` for colour, font family, font size, font weight, line height, letter spacing, spacing (margin, padding, gap), radius, border width, shadow, gradient, duration, easing and z-index. ## 5. Acceptance criteria

The story has no Gherkin scenarios, so every AC is derived. Conventions:

- "I completed step 1 in Colombia / Chile" uses the values of US-01-AC-04 / US-02 §5 conventions;
  the date is typed as "15/05/1990" (stored "1990-05-15").
- Today is pinned to **2026-11-21** unless a scenario says otherwise.
- "Narrow" is 360 × 740, "tablet" 768 × 1024, "desktop" 1280 × 800 CSS px.
- Copy in quotes that is not Strapi content is in §8.1.

### US-04-AC-01 — Tokens in one file, no loose values (derived from US-04-BR-01)

```gherkin
Scenario: Tokens in one file, no loose values
  Given the production style files of frontend/src
  Then exactly one file declares custom properties, in three tiers with distinct prefixes
  And no other style file contains a hex, rgb(), hsl(), oklch() or named colour, a px/rem/em length outside @media and @container conditions,
    a font-family name, a box-shadow or gradient literal, a ms/s duration, a cubic-bezier() or a numeric z-index
  And no component style file references a primitive token
  And every breakpoint used in a @media or @container condition is a min-width equal to one --breakpoint-* value of the token file
  And every other media feature in a condition is prefers-reduced-motion, forced-colors, prefers-color-scheme or (hover: hover)
  And the guard reports a fixture string with one violation of each kind (sensitivity self-test)
```

778	## 9. Non-functional requirements
779	
780	- **Accessibility:** WCAG 2.2 AA; WAI-ARIA APG combobox (select-only and list autocomplete) and
781	  date picker dialog patterns; visible focus on the focused element; Tab order unchanged except the
782	  "Elegir fecha" stop; one `h1` per page; decorative icons and flags hidden; `forced-colors`
783	  fallbacks for gradient text and borders; screen reader pass at HC3 (NVDA or VoiceOver) on the
784	  select (both kinds, including how a collapsed combobox without `aria-controls` is announced,
785	  ADR-0012), the calendar, the year list and the step indicator.
786	- **Responsive:** mobile-first CSS (`min-width` queries on the `--breakpoint-*` tokens); 320–1440
787	  CSS px with no horizontal scroll (verified at 360, 768, 1280); 44 × 44 px targets; bottom sheet
788	  below `--breakpoint-sheet` (600 px), fitting above the on-screen keyboard on phones (HC3 phone
789	  check, AC-12).
790	- **Multi-country:** one build; no country branch except the presentation map
791	  `country-visuals.ts` (ADR-0011, enforced by the static guard of AC-03); calendar names, date
792	  formatting and the first day of the week from `Intl`/CLDR and the country `localeTag`, with no
793	  country code in the date picker; the date text format is the same for every country.
794	- **Security / privacy:** no third-party origin at runtime (fonts, icons, flags self-hosted, so no
795	  new CSP or proxy change); no value of the form in logs; no `innerHTML` for icons or flags (the
796	  existing static guard applies: icons and flags are components or inline template SVG).
797	- **Performance:** icons imported individually; fonts: one latin-subset variable WOFF2 file per
798	  family with the weight range limited to the scale (BR-12), text face preloaded; the step 1 page is
799	  lazy-loaded (`loadComponent`, ADR-0012 §7) so `@angular/aria`, `@angular/cdk` and the step 1
800	  icons stay out of the initial bundle; the production build stays within the existing
801	  `angular.json` budgets (initial 500 kB warning, 1 MB error; component styles 4 kB warning, 8 kB
802	  error), which are not changed. Movement animates `transform` and `opacity` only; state
803	  transitions may change paint-only properties (colours, border colour, shadow); no layout
804	  property is animated (ADR-0013).
805	- **Maintainability:** tokens in one file; new shared components and pure functions under
806	  `src/app/shared/` with the names of ADR-0012 §2 (`CustomSelect`, `DateField`, `Calendar`,
807	  `date-text.ts`, `calendar-dates.ts`, `select-search.ts`), ADR-0010 (`field-icons.ts`, flag
808	  components under `shared/flags/`) and ADR-0011 (`country-visuals.ts`); others per CLAUDE.md §6
809	  (for example `step-indicator.ts` → `StepIndicator`).
810	- **Language:** end-user copy Spanish; code, docs English.

**HC3 phone check (manual, BR-11):** on a real phone (both countries), focus "Ciudad" and type
into it: the bottom sheet sits above the on-screen keyboard, and the search input, the active
option and at least one option row stay visible while the keyboard is up. The e2e viewport has
no on-screen keyboard, so this part is manual. If it fails, the ADR-0012 fallback (a sheet with
its own search box, a dialog) changes the ARIA pattern on narrow screens and needs a spec change
first (ADR-0012 *Spec impact* 5).

### US-04-AC-13 — Step indicator and wizard header (derived from US-04-BR-09, BR-08 / Q-17)

```gherkin
Scenario Outline: Step indicator and wizard header
  Given I am on <page> in Colombia
  Then the step indicator lists "Tus datos", "Plan", "Resumen y pago" in this order
  And <current> has aria-current="step" and the text "Paso <n> de 3" is available to assistive technology
  And steps before it are marked "completado"
  And neither the indicator nor the header contains a focusable element or a heading

  Examples:
    | page          | current          | n |
    | "/co/datos"   | "Tus datos"      | 1 |
    | "/co/planes"  | "Plan"           | 2 |
    | "/co/resumen" | "Resumen y pago" | 3 |

Scenario: Indicator on the confirmation
  When the payment is confirmed
  Then all three steps are marked "completado" and none has aria-current
```

### US-04-AC-14 — Step transition keeps focus and one page (derived from US-04-BR-09 / Q-14)

```gherkin
Scenario: Step transition keeps focus and one page
  Given motion is allowed and I completed step 1 in Colombia
  When I activate "Continuar"
  Then at no moment during the transition does the document contain more than one h1 or more than one main
  And the focus ends on the h1 "Elige tu plan" and the document title is "Elige tu plan | Cotizador de seguro de auto"
  And the transition lasts at most the "slow" duration token
```

The transition is enter-only (`animate.enter` on the arriving page, no `animate.leave`), so the
leaving page is removed at once (ADR-0013 §2). The "slow" token is `--duration-slow` (320 ms); the
page enter uses `--duration-base` (200 ms). A `MutationObserver` installed before "Continuar"
records the maximum `h1` and `main` counts (ADR-0013 §4).

### US-04-AC-15 — Skeletons while content loads (derived from US-04-BR-09 / Q-15)

```gherkin
Scenario Outline: Skeletons while content loads
  Given the content backend has not answered the <request> request yet
  When <place> is shown
  Then skeleton shapes are shown, hidden from assistive technology
  And the text "<loading text>" is still in the polite live region
  When the content arrives
  Then the skeleton is replaced by the content

  Examples:
    | request     | place                  | loading text |
    | form fields | step 1 in Colombia     | Cargando formulario… |
    | plans       | step 2 in Colombia     | Cargando planes… |
    | terms       | the summary terms      | Cargando términos y condiciones… |
    | countries   | the country chooser    | Cargando… |
```

### US-04-AC-16 — Interactive plan cards (derived from US-04-BR-09)

```gherkin
Scenario: Interactive plan cards
  Given step 2 is shown in Chile
  When I click the short description of "Plan Premium"
  Then the radio "Plan Premium" is checked and no other plan is
  And "Plan Protegido" keeps the "Recomendado" badge and the recommended style
  And each coverage and benefit item shows a check-circle icon hidden from assistive technology
  When I use the arrow keys in the plan group
  Then the choice follows the native radio behaviour of US-02-AC-16, unchanged
```

### US-04-AC-17 — Reduced motion (derived from US-04-BR-10)

```gherkin
Scenario: Reduced motion
  Given the browser reports prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
  When I go through step 1 (opening "Ciudad" and the calendar), step 2, the summary and the confirmation in Colombia
  Then at every page and with every panel open, every element's computed animation-duration and transition-duration are 0s
  And document.getAnimations() returns an empty list

Scenario: Reduced motion by construction
  Given the production style files and sources of frontend/src
  Then outside tokens.css every animation and transition declaration is inside a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) block
  And tokens.css sets every --duration-* and --delay-* token to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
  And every CDK overlay and dialog is created with disableAnimations: true
```

The second scenario is the static guard of ADR-0013 §4. `disableAnimations` matters because the
CDK backdrop otherwise keeps a 1 ms transition under reduced motion (ADR-0013 §3).

### US-04-AC-18 — Responsive at the three sizes (derived from US-04-BR-11 / Q-18)

```gherkin
Scenario Outline: Responsive at the three sizes
  Given the viewport is <width> × <height>
  When I open, in <country>, the country chooser, step 1, step 1 with "Ciudad" open, step 1 with the calendar open,
    step 1 after a failed "Continuar", step 2, the summary and the confirmation
  Then no page has horizontal scroll
  And every interactive element has a hit box of at least 44 × 44 CSS px (checkbox and radio: input plus its label)
  And on step 2 the plans are <plan layout>

  Examples:
    | width | height | country  | plan layout |
    | 360   | 740    | Colombia | in one column (each card's left edge at the same x) |
    | 360   | 740    | Chile    | in one column |
    | 768   | 1024   | Colombia | in one or more columns, without overflow |
    | 768   | 1024   | Chile    | in one or more columns, without overflow |
    | 1280  | 800    | Colombia | in at least two columns (at least two cards share a top y) |
    | 1280  | 800    | Chile    | in at least two columns |
```

### US-04-AC-19 — Fonts and assets are local (derived from US-04-BR-12 / Q-08)

```gherkin
Scenario: Fonts and assets are local
  When I go through the whole flow in Colombia
  Then every request the browser sends goes to the app's own origin
  And every font request is a WOFF2 file under /fonts/, at most one file per family and at most two families
  And the production styles declare at most two @font-face families, each with one WOFF2 src on the app origin, font-display: swap and a font-weight range
  And any other family name in a font-family declaration is a local system fallback that is never requested
```

With variable fonts each family is one file covering a weight range (BR-12, ADR-0010 §5); the
static guard counts `@font-face` families, and the e2e counts font requests.

### US-04-AC-20 — Accessibility kept (derived from US-04-BR-13, BR-04)

```gherkin
Scenario Outline: Heading outline per page
  When <page> is shown in Chile
  Then the heading outline is exactly <outline>

  Examples:
    | page          | outline |
    | step 1        | h1 "Tus datos y los de tu vehículo" |
    | step 2        | h1 "Elige tu plan"; h2 per plan name; h3 "Coberturas" / "Beneficios" under each |
    | summary       | h1 "Resumen de tu cotización"; h2 "Tus datos", "Tu vehículo", "Plan elegido", "Términos y condiciones"; h3 terms title; terms body from h4 (ADR-0009) |
    | confirmation  | h1 "Pago confirmado" |

Scenario: Visible focus on the new controls
  When I focus "Ciudad", "Fecha de nacimiento", "Elegir fecha", a calendar day and a select option row with the keyboard
  Then each shows a focus indicator on the focused element (outline or box-shadow)
```

The keyboard order is proven by the existing tests of US-01-AC-24, US-02-AC-16 and US-03-AC-16,
which keep their assertions (§11.1). Screen reader pass at HC3.

### US-04-AC-21 — New dependencies pinned and licensed (derived from US-04-BR-14)

Scenario: New dependencies pinned and licensed
  Then every version in frontend/package.json is exact (no ^, ~ or range)
  And the dependency names are exactly the pre-US-04 list plus the additions accepted in the US-04 ADRs

The accepted additions are the five of BR-14: `@lucide/angular` 1.77.0,

Scenario: Before and after evidence
  Then docs/qa/US-04/after/ contains, for CO and CL at 360x740, 768x1024 and 1280x800:
    00-paises, 01-datos, 01b-datos-select-open, 01c-datos-calendar-open, 01d-datos-errors,

### US-04-AC-23 — Visual quality and originality (derived from US-04-BR-02, BR-09, BR-16)

### 7.1 Strapi

**No change.** US-04 reads the same content as US-01..US-03 (ADR-0001, ADR-0006). The country
`name` and `localeTag` already provided are enough for the header, the calendar names and the
calendar's first day of the week. ADR-0011 keeps the flag and accent in the front end, so no
`country` attribute is added.

### 7.2 Front-end presentation maps (code, not content)

| Map | Key | Value | Fallback |
|---|---|---|---|
| Field icon (`shared/field-icons.ts`, ADR-0010 §7) | field `key` | `@lucide/angular` component for `documentType`, `documentNumber`, `fullName`, `birthDate`, `city`, `plate`, `make`, `model`, `vehicleYear` (names in AC-04) | `LucidePencilLine` for any other key of type `text`, `number`, `select`, `date`; none for `checkbox` |

## 9. Non-functional requirements

- **Accessibility:** WCAG 2.2 AA; WAI-ARIA APG combobox (select-only and list autocomplete) and
  date picker dialog patterns; visible focus on the focused element; Tab order unchanged except the
  "Elegir fecha" stop; one `h1` per page; decorative icons and flags hidden; `forced-colors`
  fallbacks for gradient text and borders; screen reader pass at HC3 (NVDA or VoiceOver) on the
  select (both kinds, including how a collapsed combobox without `aria-controls` is announced,
  ADR-0012), the calendar, the year list and the step indicator.
- **Responsive:** mobile-first CSS (`min-width` queries on the `--breakpoint-*` tokens); 320–1440
  CSS px with no horizontal scroll (verified at 360, 768, 1280); 44 × 44 px targets; bottom sheet
  below `--breakpoint-sheet` (600 px), fitting above the on-screen keyboard on phones (HC3 phone
  check, AC-12).
- **Multi-country:** one build; no country branch except the presentation map
  `country-visuals.ts` (ADR-0011, enforced by the static guard of AC-03); calendar names, date
  formatting and the first day of the week from `Intl`/CLDR and the country `localeTag`, with no
  country code in the date picker; the date text format is the same for every country.
- **Security / privacy:** no third-party origin at runtime (fonts, icons, flags self-hosted, so no
  new CSP or proxy change); no value of the form in logs; no `innerHTML` for icons or flags (the
  existing static guard applies: icons and flags are components or inline template SVG).
- **Performance:** icons imported individually; fonts: one latin-subset variable WOFF2 file per
  family with the weight range limited to the scale (BR-12), text face preloaded; the step 1 page is
  lazy-loaded (`loadComponent`, ADR-0012 §7) so `@angular/aria`, `@angular/cdk` and the step 1
  icons stay out of the initial bundle; the production build stays within the existing
  `angular.json` budgets (initial 500 kB warning, 1 MB error; component styles 4 kB warning, 8 kB
  error), which are not changed. Movement animates `transform` and `opacity` only; state
  transitions may change paint-only properties (colours, border colour, shadow); no layout
  property is animated (ADR-0013).
- **Maintainability:** tokens in one file; new shared components and pure functions under
  `src/app/shared/` with the names of ADR-0012 §2 (`CustomSelect`, `DateField`, `Calendar`,
  `date-text.ts`, `calendar-dates.ts`, `select-search.ts`), ADR-0010 (`field-icons.ts`, flag
  components under `shared/flags/`) and ADR-0011 (`country-visuals.ts`); others per CLAUDE.md §6
  (for example `step-indicator.ts` → `StepIndicator`).
- **Language:** end-user copy Spanish; code, docs English.

9	# ADR-0010: Design tokens and visual language (theme, palette, type, scales, icons, flags)
10	
11	## Context and Problem Statement
12	
13	US-04 redesigns every page of the wizard on a tokenized design system (`specs/US-04/spec.md` §1,
14	BR-01..BR-04, BR-12). Today the front end has twelve colour custom properties in `styles.css`
15	and literal lengths, colours and fonts spread over six component style files. The story asks for
16	tokens in one file in three tiers with no loose values in components, AA contrast proven over
17	gradients and a dotted texture, two self-hosted font families, one icon library imported icon by
18	icon, and flags. The human's visual direction (spec "Sources") pins the look: a deep near-black
19	background with a subtle dotted texture, a violet/indigo accent, a recommended plan card with a
20	vertical violet gradient and a soft glow, rounded cards with thin borders, pill segmented
21	controls, check-circle icons in lists, large bold display headings and high-contrast light
22	primary buttons. The story's first deliverable is this proposal with an example palette and type
23	scale (story, "First deliverable"). This ADR decides the token architecture and how it is
24	enforced, the theme (US-04-Q-01), the palette and its contrast proof (Q-03), the type (Q-08), the
25	scales, the icon library and field-key map (Q-09) and the flag assets (Q-10). Where the flags and
26	the per-country accent come from, and how that squares with ADR-0001, is ADR-0011.
27	
28	## Decision Drivers
29	
30	- D1. One token file, three tiers, no loose values in components, checked automatically
31	  (US-04-BR-01, US-04-AC-01; CLAUDE.md §9: "checked mechanically").
32	- D2. WCAG 2.2 AA: 4.5:1 text, 3:1 large text, UI component boundaries, focus indicators and
33	  meaningful icons, at every gradient stop and over the texture (US-04-BR-02, US-04-AC-02; story
34	  rules "AA contrast"). The pair list must be machine-readable so the test does not guess (AC-02
35	  note).
36	- D3. The human's visual direction above is the brief. CLAUDE.md §5 (`frontend-design`
37	  overrides): "the brief's words win, including when the approved direction matches one of the
38	  skill's generated defaults"; no aesthetic risk beyond the accepted ADR; the wizard is a task flow.
39	- D4. At most two font families, self-hosted, WOFF2, `font-display: swap`, at most the weights the
40	  type scale uses, no third-party origin at runtime (US-04-BR-12, US-04-AC-19; ADR-0002: the
41	  browser talks only to its own origin).
42	- D5. One icon library, icons imported one by one, no icon font, no runtime fetch, decorative icons
43	  hidden; exact version, permissive licence, compatible with `@angular/core` 22.3.0 (US-04-BR-04,
44	  BR-14; CLAUDE.md §4).
45	- D6. No `innerHTML` anywhere in the front end (ADR-0009; `static-guards.spec.ts`, US-03-AC-13;
46	  spec §9 "no `innerHTML` for icons or flags").
47	- D7. Bundle budgets of `angular.json` (initial 500 kB warning / 1 MB error; component style 4 kB
48	  warning / 8 kB error) are kept or a change is justified (spec §9, Performance).
49	- D8. Few new dependencies, each pinned exactly, licence reviewed (US-04-BR-14; CLAUDE.md §4).

51	## Considered Options
52	
53	Four sub-decisions, each with its own options. The chosen one is marked.
54	
55	**A. Enforcing "no loose values"**
56	
57	1. **A1. A static-guard test in Vitest** (chosen) that reads the style files, like the existing
58	   `static-guards.spec.ts` of ADR-0008 and ADR-0009.
59	2. **A2. Stylelint** `18.1.0` with `stylelint-declaration-strict-value` `1.13.0` (both MIT), pinned
60	   devDependencies, run by `npm run lint`.
61	
62	**B. Theme (US-04-Q-01)**
63	
64	1. **B1. Dark only** (chosen), `color-scheme: dark`; semantic tokens structured so a light theme can
65	   be added later by redefining the semantic tier.
66	2. **B2. Dark and light following `prefers-color-scheme`**, no switch.
67	
68	**C. Icon library (US-04-Q-09)**
69	
70	1. **C1. `@lucide/angular` `1.77.0`** (chosen): one standalone component per icon.
71	2. **C2. `@ng-icons/core` `36.1.0` + `@ng-icons/lucide` `36.1.0`**: one generic `<ng-icon>` and
72	   icon SVG strings registered by name.
73	3. **C3. `lucide-angular` `1.0.0`**, the package the story names (verified non-viable, see below).
74	
75	**D. Font families (US-04-Q-08)**
76	
77	1. **D1. Archivo (display, width axis) + Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (text)** (chosen).
78	2. **D2. One family only**: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for everything.
79	3. **D3. The spec's starting candidates**: "Sora" or "Space Grotesk" + "Inter".

81	## Decision Outcome
82	
83	Chosen options: **A1 static guard, B1 dark only, C1 `@lucide/angular@1.77.0`, D1 Archivo +
84	Atkinson Hyperlegible Next**, because they meet D1–D8 with **three** new runtime dependencies
85	(one icon package, two font packages) and no new tooling. A1 extends a guard pattern the gate
86	already runs. B1 is the brief. C1 is the maintained Angular package of the library the story
87	proposes, renders through template bindings (D6) and hides icons by default. D1 grounds the type
88	in the subject: plates, RUT and document numbers need unambiguous glyphs, and the display face
89	comes from a Latin American foundry with a width axis that makes the bold display headings of
90	the brief a deliberate treatment, not a default.

Listed first in `angular.json` `styles`. |

101	| component `*.css` | Component styles | Semantic and component tokens only; no primitive. |

106	|---|---|---|---|
107	| Primitive | `--primitive-` | `--primitive-violet-400`, `--primitive-ink-950` | `tokens.css` only |

114	`linear-gradient(<angle>deg, var(--…) P%, …)` or, for the texture only,
115	`radial-gradient(...)` of one translucent colour token; everything else is a `var()` or a length,

125	- Outside `tokens.css`, no hex colour, `rgb(`/`rgba(`/`hsl(`/`hwb(`/`lab(`/`lch(`/`oklab(`/`oklch(`/

312	  `color: currentColor`), not from the `size` input.
313	- **Field-key map** (`frontend/src/app/shared/field-icons.ts`, a pure map plus
314	  `iconForField(config)`; names verified as exports of `@lucide/angular@1.77.0`):
315	
316	  | Field key | Icon | Field key | Icon |
317	  |---|---|---|---|
318	  | `documentType` | `LucideIdCard` | `plate` | `LucideRectangleHorizontal` |
319	  | `documentNumber` | `LucideHash` | `make` | `LucideCar` |
320	  | `fullName` | `LucideUser` | `model` | `LucideCarFront` |
321	  | `birthDate` | `LucideCalendar` | `vehicleYear` | `LucideCalendarRange` |
322	  | `city` | `LucideMapPin` | **any other** `text`/`number`/`select`/`date` key | `LucidePencilLine` (default) |
323	  | `checkbox` fields | none | | |
324	
325	- Other icons: help `LucideInfo`, error `LucideCircleAlert`, success and list items
326	  `LucideCircleCheck`, select chevron `LucideChevronDown`, selected option `LucideCheck`, search
327	  `LucideSearch`, close `LucideX`, months `LucideChevronLeft`/`LucideChevronRight`, date button
328	  `LucideCalendarDays`, processing `LucideLoaderCircle`, unknown-country fallback `LucideEarth`,
329	  step indicator `LucideUserRound` / `LucideShieldCheck` / `LucideReceipt`. Avoid
330	  `credit-card`-style names and any class or file named `…card…` in `.ts`/`.html` of files without
331	  the "no se realiza ningún cobro" copy: the US-03-AC-15 guard (`/tarjeta|\bcard\b/i`) would fail.
332	- **Bundle impact, measured** (production build of a copy of `frontend/` at HEAD in a temporary
333	  directory, `@angular/build` 22.3.0; baseline initial `main` 381.44 kB raw / 98.94 kB transfer):
334	  1 icon +11.33 kB raw / +2.26 kB transfer; 22 icons +78.24 kB raw / **+4.20 kB** transfer. Each
335	  icon compiles its own copy of the shared template (about 3.2 kB raw each), which compresses
336	  well. ADR-0012 keeps the initial bundle under the 500 kB warning by lazy-loading step 1.
337	
338	#### 8. Flags
339	
340	Our own SVGs, one standalone component per flag under `frontend/src/app/shared/flags/`, written by
341	hand from the published constructions (no library): Colombia 2:3, three horizontal bands 2:1:1
342	yellow/blue/red; Chile 2:3, two equal bands white over red, a blue square canton the height of the
343	white band, a white five-pointed star centred in the canton on a circle whose diameter is half the
344	canton side (Wikipedia, "Flag of Colombia" and "Flag of Chile", read 2026-11-21; neither law fixes
345	exact colours, so the colour values are the published approximations, ADR-0011). Each is `viewBox`
346	geometry only (`rect`, one `polygon`), fills from component tokens through CSS classes (no hex in
347	templates), `aria-hidden="true"`, `focusable="false"`, no `<title>`, no text; under 1 kB of
348	template each. A 1 px `--color-border-control` ring (4.23:1 on the header) separates the dark blue
349	areas from the near-black background. Where the flags appear and what replaces them for other
350	countries: ADR-0011.
351	
352	### Consequences
353	
354	- Good, because every value has one home and one name; the guard makes "no loose values" a gate
355	  failure, not a review comment (D1), at zero dependency cost (D8).
356	- Good, because the contrast proof is a test over the real token file: a tuned colour that breaks a
357	  pair fails the gate, gradients included (D2).
358	- Good, because the semantic tier isolates components from raw values: a light theme or a palette
359	  change touches `tokens.css` only.
360	- Good, because the icon package is the maintained one, compatible with Angular 22.3.0, hides
361	  icons by default and has no `innerHTML` path (D5, D6); the transfer cost of 22 icons is about
362	  4 kB.
363	- Good, because both fonts are OFL-1.1, same-origin, and the text face is chosen for the exact
364	  data the form collects.
365	- Bad, because a regex-based CSS guard is weaker than a real parser: a construct it does not
366	  anticipate (a value split across lines, an escape) could slip through — mitigation: the style
367	  files are small and simple; the sensitivity self-test covers each rule; the code-reviewer still
368	  reads the CSS; A2 remains the upgrade path.
369	- Bad, because `@lucide/angular` costs about 3.2 kB **raw** per icon (each icon is a component), so
370	  the raw initial size grows faster than the transfer size — mitigation: icons used only on step 1
371	  move to the lazy chunk (ADR-0012); budgets are measured on every build.
372	- Bad, because the Archivo width-axis file is 90 kB, about 55 kB more than its weight-only file
373	  (`archivo-latin-wght-normal.woff2`, 34,928 bytes) — mitigation: not preloaded, `swap`, used only
374	  for headings and prices, cached after the first visit; if HC2 prefers bytes over the width
375	  treatment, switching to the weight-only file is a one-line change.
376	- Bad, because a 3:1 border on every interactive card and input is heavier than the "thin, subtle"
377	  borders of the reference — mitigation: 1 px width, and subtle hairlines stay on non-interactive
378	  panels only (*Spec impact* 2).
379	- Neutral: the dark-only theme means users with a light-mode preference get the dark UI; that is
380	  the brief.
381	
382	### Strongest argument against
383	
384	Stylelint (A2) is the standard tool for exactly this rule: it parses CSS with PostCSS, reports
385	the line and column in the editor while the developer types, has a maintained
386	`declaration-strict-value` plugin, and `stylelint-config-standard` would catch a whole class of
387	other CSS mistakes for free. A home-made regex guard re-implements a parser badly, will drift as
388	the CSS grows, and gives feedback only when the test suite runs. Adding two pinned, MIT-licensed
389	devDependencies is a small price for that.
390	
391	**Why we accept it:** the rule set here is narrow and project-specific (tier prefixes, "no
392	primitive in components", breakpoints that must equal token values, a single declaring file), so
393	Stylelint would need custom rules or plugin configuration for most of it anyway, plus a lint-step
394	change. The repository already enforces ADR rules as Vitest static guards that run in the gate
395	(ADR-0008, ADR-0009), and the sensitivity self-test makes a silent pass visible. If the guard
396	proves brittle during implementation or review, A2 is a contained switch: add the two
397	devDependencies through a superseding note and delete the guard.
398	
399	### Confirmation
400

# ADR-0010: Design tokens and visual language (theme, palette, type, scales, icons, flags)

## Context and Problem Statement

US-04 redesigns every page of the wizard on a tokenized design system (`specs/US-04/spec.md` §1,
BR-01..BR-04, BR-12). Today the front end has twelve colour custom properties in `styles.css`
and literal lengths, colours and fonts spread over six component style files. The story asks for
tokens in one file in three tiers with no loose values in components, AA contrast proven over
gradients and a dotted texture, two self-hosted font families, one icon library imported icon by
icon, and flags. The human's visual direction (spec "Sources") pins the look: a deep near-black
background with a subtle dotted texture, a violet/indigo accent, a recommended plan card with a
vertical violet gradient and a soft glow, rounded cards with thin borders, pill segmented
controls, check-circle icons in lists, large bold display headings and high-contrast light
primary buttons. The story's first deliverable is this proposal with an example palette and type
scale (story, "First deliverable"). This ADR decides the token architecture and how it is
enforced, the theme (US-04-Q-01), the palette and its contrast proof (Q-03), the type (Q-08), the
scales, the icon library and field-key map (Q-09) and the flag assets (Q-10). Where the flags and
the per-country accent come from, and how that squares with ADR-0001, is ADR-0011.

## Decision Drivers

- D1. One token file, three tiers, no loose values in components, checked automatically
  (US-04-BR-01, US-04-AC-01; CLAUDE.md §9: "checked mechanically").
- D2. WCAG 2.2 AA: 4.5:1 text, 3:1 large text, UI component boundaries, focus indicators and
  meaningful icons, at every gradient stop and over the texture (US-04-BR-02, US-04-AC-02; story
  rules "AA contrast"). The pair list must be machine-readable so the test does not guess (AC-02
  note).
- D3. The human's visual direction above is the brief. CLAUDE.md §5 (`frontend-design`
  overrides): "the brief's words win, including when the approved direction matches one of the
  skill's generated defaults"; no aesthetic risk beyond the accepted ADR; the wizard is a task flow.
- D4. At most two font families, self-hosted, WOFF2, `font-display: swap`, at most the weights the
  type scale uses, no third-party origin at runtime (US-04-BR-12, US-04-AC-19; ADR-0002: the
  browser talks only to its own origin).
- D5. One icon library, icons imported one by one, no icon font, no runtime fetch, decorative icons
  hidden; exact version, permissive licence, compatible with `@angular/core` 22.3.0 (US-04-BR-04,
  BR-14; CLAUDE.md §4).
- D6. No `innerHTML` anywhere in the front end (ADR-0009; `static-guards.spec.ts`, US-03-AC-13;
  spec §9 "no `innerHTML` for icons or flags").
- D7. Bundle budgets of `angular.json` (initial 500 kB warning / 1 MB error; component style 4 kB
  warning / 8 kB error) are kept or a change is justified (spec §9, Performance).
- D8. Few new dependencies, each pinned exactly, licence reviewed (US-04-BR-14; CLAUDE.md §4).

## Considered Options

Four sub-decisions, each with its own options. The chosen one is marked.

**A. Enforcing "no loose values"**

1. **A1. A static-guard test in Vitest** (chosen) that reads the style files, like the existing
   `static-guards.spec.ts` of ADR-0008 and ADR-0009.
2. **A2. Stylelint** `18.1.0` with `stylelint-declaration-strict-value` `1.13.0` (both MIT), pinned
   devDependencies, run by `npm run lint`.

**B. Theme (US-04-Q-01)**

1. **B1. Dark only** (chosen), `color-scheme: dark`; semantic tokens structured so a light theme can
   be added later by redefining the semantic tier.
2. **B2. Dark and light following `prefers-color-scheme`**, no switch.

**C. Icon library (US-04-Q-09)**

1. **C1. `@lucide/angular` `1.77.0`** (chosen): one standalone component per icon.
2. **C2. `@ng-icons/core` `36.1.0` + `@ng-icons/lucide` `36.1.0`**: one generic `<ng-icon>` and
   icon SVG strings registered by name.
3. **C3. `lucide-angular` `1.0.0`**, the package the story names (verified non-viable, see below).

**D. Font families (US-04-Q-08)**

1. **D1. Archivo (display, width axis) + Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (text)** (chosen).
2. **D2. One family only**: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for everything.
3. **D3. The spec's starting candidates**: "Sora" or "Space Grotesk" + "Inter".

## Decision Outcome

Chosen options: **A1 static guard, B1 dark only, C1 `@lucide/angular@1.77.0`, D1 Archivo +
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next**, because they meet D1–D8 with **three** new runtime dependencies
(one icon package, two font packages) and no new tooling. A1 extends a guard pattern the gate
already runs. B1 is the brief. C1 is the maintained Angular package of the library the story
proposes, renders through template bindings (D6) and hides icons by default. D1 grounds the type
in the subject: plates, RUT and document numbers need unambiguous glyphs, and the display face
comes from a Latin American foundry with a width axis that makes the bold display headings of
the brief a deliberate treatment, not a default.

### What is decided

#### 1. Files and tiers

| File | Holds | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `frontend/src/styles/tokens.css` | Every custom property of the app, the two `@font-face` rules, the `prefers-reduced-motion` and country-accent overrides of tokens (ADR-0011, ADR-0013) | The **only** file that declares a custom property (`--…:`) or `@font-face`. Listed first in `angular.json` `styles`. |
| `frontend/src/styles/contrast-pairs.json` | The AC-02 pair list (format in §4) | Read by the contrast test; never by the app. |
| `frontend/src/styles.css` | Reset, element defaults, focus style, utility classes (`.visually-hidden`) | Semantic and component tokens only. |
| component `*.css` | Component styles | Semantic and component tokens only; no primitive. |

Tier prefixes (the guard keys on them):

| Tier | Prefix | Examples | Who may reference it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Primitive | `--primitive-` | `--primitive-violet-400`, `--primitive-ink-950` | `tokens.css` only |
| Semantic | `--color-`, `--font-`, `--text-`, `--leading-`, `--tracking-`, `--weight-`, `--space-`, `--size-`, `--radius-`, `--border-`, `--shadow-`, `--gradient-`, `--texture-`, `--duration-`, `--ease-`, `--z-`, `--breakpoint-`, `--focus-` | `--color-text-muted`, `--space-4`, `--duration-base` | any style file |
| Component | `--component-<name>-` | `--component-button-primary-bg`, `--component-plan-recommended-gradient` | any style file |

Value forms allowed **inside `tokens.css`** (so the contrast test can resolve every pair without
a CSS engine): primitives are 6-digit hex (`#RRGGBB`); a translucent colour is
`color-mix(in srgb, var(--primitive-…) N%, transparent)`; a gradient is
`linear-gradient(<angle>deg, var(--…) P%, …)` or, for the texture only,
`radial-gradient(...)` of one translucent colour token; everything else is a `var()` or a length,
number, duration or `cubic-bezier()`.

#### 2. "No loose values": the static guard (A1)

A Vitest spec (extending `frontend/src/app/static-guards.spec.ts` or a new `design-guards.spec.ts`,
test-engineer's choice) reads every `*.css` under `frontend/src` and asserts, with comments
stripped:

- Only `tokens.css` contains a custom-property declaration or `@font-face`.
- Outside `tokens.css`, no hex colour, `rgb(`/`rgba(`/`hsl(`/`hwb(`/`lab(`/`lch(`/`oklab(`/`oklch(`/
  `color-mix(`, no named colour other than `transparent`, `currentColor`, `inherit` and the
  `forced-colors` system colours (`Canvas`, `CanvasText`, `LinkText`, `Highlight`,
  `HighlightText`, `ButtonText`, `ButtonFace`, `GrayText`); no `font-family` value other than
  `var(--…)` or `inherit`; no `px`/`rem`/`em`/`ch`/`vw`/`vh` length outside `@media`/`@container`
  conditions; no `ms`/`s` duration, `cubic-bezier(`, gradient function, `box-shadow`/`text-shadow`
  literal or numeric `z-index`. Allowed literals: those listed in US-04-BR-01.
- No component style file references `--primitive-`.
- Every length in a `@media`/`@container` condition equals one `--breakpoint-*` value of
  `tokens.css`, and only `min-width` is used (mobile-first, US-04-BR-11), except the
  `prefers-reduced-motion`, `forced-colors` and `prefers-color-scheme` media features.
- A sensitivity self-test: a fixture string with one violation of each kind must be reported
  (the guard must not pass by finding nothing). Same idea as the "the guard looks at something"
  test of US-03-AC-13.

Third-party CSS that Angular libraries inject themselves (the CDK overlay styles, ADR-0012) is not
in `frontend/src` and is out of the guard's scope; our overrides of it live in `styles.css` and
use tokens.

#### 3. Theme (B1)

Dark only. `:root { color-scheme: dark; }`. No `prefers-color-scheme` branch, no switch. The
semantic tier is the only one components see, so a later light theme redefines semantic tokens
in one block of `tokens.css` and needs its own contrast rows; nothing in components changes.

#### 4. Palette (example values, verified)

Built as OKLCH ramps (even lightness steps at a fixed hue; a principle restated from
`pbakaus/impeccable` `colorize.md`, Apache-2.0, credited per EVAL-004) and stored as sRGB hex for
exact contrast computation. The near-black is tinted with the brand hue (286°) so neutrals and
violet read as one family. This is the brief's "deep near-black" (CLAUDE.md §5: the brief wins
over the skill's "tinted near-black" calibration note); the deliberate part is the shared hue.

| Primitive | Hex | OKLCH (L C h) | Role (semantic token) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ink-950` | `#0B0B14` | 0.155 0.018 286 | page background `--color-bg`; text on light buttons |
| `ink-900` | `#14131E` | 0.195 0.022 286 | card surface `--color-surface` |
| `ink-850` | `#1D1C2A` | 0.235 0.026 286 | raised surface: header, inputs, panels, calendar `--color-surface-raised` |
| `ink-800` | `#272736` | 0.28 0.028 286 | hover and active option row `--color-surface-hover` |
| `ink-700` | `#3B3B4C` | 0.36 0.03 286 | decorative hairline of non-interactive panels `--color-border-subtle` |
| `ink-500` | `#7E7E93` | 0.60 0.032 286 | control and interactive-card border `--color-border-control`, flag ring, disabled text |
| `ink-300` | `#BCBCCC` | 0.80 0.022 286 | muted text, decorative icons `--color-text-muted` |
| `ink-50` | `#F6F6FB` | 0.975 0.006 286 | body text `--color-text` |
| `violet-200` | `#D8D0FF` | 0.88 0.07 293 | bottom stop of the primary button; muted text on the recommended card |
| `violet-300` | `#C0B0FE` | 0.80 0.12 293 | focus ring `--color-focus`, links, display-gradient end, "Recomendado" badge |
| `violet-400` | `#AA8FFF` | 0.72 0.17 293 | brand: selected, current step, chosen plan border, selected day `--color-brand` |
| `violet-500` | `#9060FB` | 0.62 0.22 293 | glow colour (decorative) |
| `violet-700` | `#6427C4` | 0.46 0.22 293 | recommended gradient top |
| `violet-800` | `#4F1B9E` | 0.39 0.19 293 | recommended gradient middle |
| `indigo-950` | `#16154D` | 0.24 0.10 277 | recommended gradient bottom |
| `red-300` | `#FF9592` | 0.78 0.13 22 | error text, icon, border `--color-error` |
| `green-300` | `#74E29F` | 0.83 0.14 155 | success, completed step, check-circles `--color-success` |
| `white` | `#FFFFFF` | — | primary button top stop, text on the recommended card, texture dots |

Country primitives (flag artwork and accents) are listed in ADR-0011.

Gradients and texture:

| Token | Value (in `tokens.css`) |
|---|---|
| `--gradient-plan-recommended` | `linear-gradient(180deg, violet-700 0%, violet-800 45%, indigo-950 100%)` |
| `--gradient-button-primary` | `linear-gradient(180deg, white 0%, violet-200 100%)` |
| `--gradient-display-text` | `linear-gradient(180deg, ink-50 0%, violet-300 100%)` (text clipped; solid `--color-text` fallback under `forced-colors: active`) |
| `--texture-dots` | `radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, white 7%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1.5px)` on `--texture-dots-gap` = `1.5rem`, page background only |
| `--shadow-glow-brand` | violet-400 at 35% as a 1 px ring + violet-500 at 45% blurred 64 px, offset 24 px (decorative) |

**Contrast table** (computed with a script: WCAG 2.x relative luminance, `(L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05)`;
"bg + dot" is the worst case of the texture: white at 7% over `ink-950` = `#1C1C24`):

| Foreground | On | Ratio (worst first) | Minimum | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| text `#F6F6FB` | bg / bg + dot / surface / raised / hover | 18.18 / **15.71** / 17.08 / 15.57 / **13.63** | 4.5 | pass |
| muted `#BCBCCC` | bg / bg + dot / surface / raised / hover | 10.45 / 9.03 / 9.81 / 8.95 / **7.84** | 4.5 | pass |
| link `#C0B0FE` | bg / bg + dot / surface / raised / hover | 10.15 / 8.77 / 9.53 / 8.69 / **7.61** | 4.5 | pass |
| error `#FF9592` | bg / bg + dot / surface / raised / hover | 9.29 / 8.03 / 8.73 / 7.96 / **6.97** | 4.5 | pass |
| success `#74E29F` | bg / bg + dot / surface / raised / hover | 12.24 / 10.57 / 11.49 / 10.48 / **9.18** | 4.5 | pass |
| control border `#7E7E93` | bg / surface / raised / hover | 4.94 / 4.64 / 4.23 / **3.70** | 3 | pass |
| focus ring `#C0B0FE` | bg / bg + dot / surface / raised | 10.15 / 8.77 / 9.53 / 8.69 | 3 | pass |
| focus ring `#C0B0FE` | recommended card at top / middle / bottom stop | **4.14** / 5.49 / 8.72 | 3 | pass |
| brand / selected `#AA8FFF` | bg / surface / raised | 7.54 / 7.08 / **6.46** | 3 | pass |
| decorative icon `#BCBCCC` | surface / raised | 9.81 / **8.95** | 3 | pass |
| button text `#0B0B14` | primary button at top `#FFFFFF` / bottom `#D8D0FF` stop | 19.59 / **13.42** | 4.5 | pass |
| primary button edge `#D8D0FF` | bg / surface | 13.42 / **12.60** | 3 | pass |
| text on recommended card `#FFFFFF` | gradient at top / middle / bottom stop | **7.99** / 10.59 / 16.82 | 4.5 | pass |
| muted on recommended card `#D8D0FF` | gradient at top / middle / bottom stop | **5.47** / 7.25 / 11.52 | 4.5 | pass |
| check-circle on recommended card `#74E29F` | gradient top stop | **4.99** | 3 | pass |
| recommended card border `#AA8FFF` | bg / surface | 7.54 / **7.08** | 3 | pass |
| display heading gradient, `#F6F6FB` stop | bg / bg + dot | 18.18 / **15.71** | 3 (large) | pass |
| display heading gradient, `#C0B0FE` stop | bg / bg + dot | 10.15 / **8.77** | 3 (large) | pass |
| text on selected day / segment on `#0B0B14` | `#AA8FFF` | **7.54** | 4.5 | pass |
| "Recomendado" badge text `#0B0B14` | `#C0B0FE` | **10.15** | 4.5 | pass |
| active option text `#F6F6FB` | `#272736` | **13.63** | 4.5 | pass |
| selected-option check `#C0B0FE` | `#272736` | **7.61** | 3 | pass |
| country accents | see ADR-0011 | ≥ 5.84 | 3 | pass |

Every gradient stop passes even the 4.5:1 text minimum, so the display heading does not depend on
the large-text exemption. Disabled text (`#7E7E93`, 4.23 on raised) is exempt under WCAG 1.4.3 and
also carries a non-colour cue (spec §8). The decorative hairline `ink-700` (`#3B3B4C`) is used only
on non-interactive panels (summary sections); WCAG 1.4.11 does not require it to reach 3:1, see
*Spec impact* 2.

**Machine-readable pair list** (`frontend/src/styles/contrast-pairs.json`): an array of
`{ "id", "fg", "bg", "min", "ac" }`, where `fg` is one token name and `bg` is a list of token names;
a gradient token in `bg` expands to all its stops; the pseudo-token `"texture-worst"` means the
texture dot colour composited over `--color-bg`. The test resolves names through `var()` chains
in `tokens.css` down to hex and fails if a name does not resolve. Example rows:

```json
[
  { "id": "body-text", "fg": "--color-text", "bg": ["--color-bg", "texture-worst", "--color-surface", "--color-surface-raised", "--color-surface-hover"], "min": 4.5, "ac": "US-04-AC-02" },
  { "id": "recommended-text", "fg": "--component-plan-recommended-text", "bg": ["--gradient-plan-recommended"], "min": 4.5, "ac": "US-04-AC-02" },
  { "id": "focus-ring", "fg": "--color-focus", "bg": ["--color-bg", "texture-worst", "--color-surface", "--color-surface-raised", "--gradient-plan-recommended"], "min": 3, "ac": "US-04-AC-02" }
]
```

The final hex values may be tuned at implementation; any change must keep every row of the file
passing, and the table above is then regenerated by the test output, not by hand.

#### 5. Typography (D1)

| Role | Family | Why this one | Package and file (self-hosted) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Display (h1, h2, prices) | **Archivo**, variable `wght` 100–900 and `wdth` 62–125 | A grotesque from Omnibus-Type, an independent foundry from Buenos Aires (omnibus-type.com, read 2026-11-21), designed for print and screen. The width axis lets headings run semi-expanded and heavy (`wdth` 112–125, `wght` 700–800): the type treatment carries the brief's "large bold display headings" instead of a size bump on a default face. | `@fontsource-variable/archivo` **5.3.0** (OFL-1.1), file `files/archivo-latin-wdth-normal.woff2`, **90,104 bytes** |
| Text (body, labels, inputs, buttons) | **Atkinson Hyperlegible Next**, variable `wght` 200–800 | Designed to increase character recognition for low-vision readers with "unambiguous, distinctive elements" (googlefonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next README, read 2026-11-21). The wizard asks for plates (`ABC123`), RUT and document numbers, where `0/O`, `1/l/I` and `5/S` confusions are real errors. | `@fontsource-variable/atkinson-hyperlegible-next` **5.3.0** (OFL-1.1), file `files/atkinson-hyperlegible-next-latin-wght-normal.woff2`, **33,996 bytes** |

Loading:

- Only the `latin` subset files are shipped (`unicode-range` `U+0000-00FF, U+0131, U+0152-0153,
  U+02BB-02BC, U+02C6, U+02DA, U+02DC, U+0304, U+0308, U+0329, U+2000-206F, U+20AC, U+2122,
  U+2191, U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD`, copied from the package CSS). It covers Spanish
  (`á é í ó ú ñ ü ¿ ¡ « »`), `$`, and `…` (used in "Cargando…"). No italic files: the terms' italic
  (ADR-0009) is synthesised by the browser.
- The two files are copied by `angular.json` `assets` entries from `node_modules/@fontsource-variable/*/files`
  to `/fonts/` (stable names, so the text face can be preloaded). Verified on a throwaway copy of
  `frontend/` with `@angular/build` 22.3.0: both files land in `dist/frontend/browser/fonts/` and
  an absolute `url('/fonts/…')` in CSS is left as written. The packages' own CSS is **not** imported.
- `@font-face` in `tokens.css`: `font-display: swap`; `font-weight` limited to the range the scale
  uses (Archivo `700 800`, `font-stretch` `100% 125%`; Atkinson `400 700`).
- `index.html` preloads the text face only:
  `<link rel="preload" href="/fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next-latin-wght-normal.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin>`.
  The display face is not preloaded (few elements; swap).
- Fallback stack after each family: `system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif`
  (local fonts, never downloaded), declared once in `tokens.css`.
- The OFL text ships inside each package (`LICENSE`); the font files keep their names; no Reserved
  Font Name is touched.

**Example type scale** (sizes from the classic scale of Bringhurst's *The Elements of Typographic
Style*: 14, 16, 18, 21, 24, 36, 48):

| Token | Size | Line height | Family / weight / width | Tracking | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--text-display` | `clamp(2rem, 1.25rem + 3.2vw, 3rem)` = 32 px at 360 → 48 px at 1280 | 1.05 | Archivo 800, `wdth` 125 | −0.02em | the page `h1`, with `--gradient-display-text` |
| `--text-price` | 2.25rem (36 px) | 1.1 | Archivo 800, `wdth` 112 | −0.01em | prices on plan cards and the summary |
| `--text-heading` | 1.5rem (24 px) | 1.25 | Archivo 700, `wdth` 112 | 0 | `h2` (plan names, summary sections) |
| `--text-subheading` | 1.3125rem (21 px) | 1.3 | Archivo 700, `wdth` 100 | 0 | `h3` ("Coberturas", "Beneficios", terms title) |
| `--text-lead` | 1.125rem (18 px) | 1.5 | Atkinson 400 | 0 | step intro and plan description |
| `--text-body` | 1rem (16 px) | 1.55 | Atkinson 400; labels and buttons 600 | 0 | body, inputs (16 px also avoids iOS input zoom), labels, buttons |
| `--text-small` | 0.875rem (14 px) | 1.45 | Atkinson 400 / 600 | 0.01em | help, errors, badges, step labels, captions |

No text below 14 px. No all-caps labels (the `frontend-design` skill's list of generated-page
tells; also harder to read). Paragraph measure `--size-measure: 68ch` (under 80 characters).
Weights used in total: Archivo 700, 800; Atkinson 400, 600 (and 700 only if a review asks for it).

#### 6. Other scales

| Scale | Tokens |
|---|---|
| Spacing (4 px base) | `--space-1` 0.25rem, `-2` 0.5rem, `-3` 0.75rem, `-4` 1rem, `-5` 1.5rem, `-6` 2rem, `-7` 3rem, `-8` 4rem |
| Radius (by hierarchy, not one radius everywhere) | `--radius-control` 0.5rem (inputs, options, days), `--radius-card` 0.875rem (plan cards, panels), `--radius-feature` 1.5rem (recommended card, sheet top corners), `--radius-pill` 999rem (segmented control, chips, badges) |
| Border width | `--border-width-hairline` 1px, `--border-width-selected` 2px, `--focus-ring-width` 3px, `--focus-ring-offset` 2px |
| Sizes | `--size-target-min` 2.75rem (44 px, BR-11), `--size-option-min` 3rem (48 px rows, Q-13), `--size-icon` 1.25rem, `--size-icon-small` 1rem, `--size-flag-height` 1rem, `--size-content-max` 72rem |
| Shadows | `--shadow-panel` (popover and sheet), `--shadow-glow-brand` (recommended and chosen plan), `--shadow-none` |
| z-index | `--z-base` 0, `--z-header` 10, `--z-overlay` 1000 (equals the CDK overlay container's own `z-index: 1000`, verified in `@angular/cdk@22.3.0` overlay styles; documented, not overridden) |
| Breakpoints (mobile-first, `em` so they follow zoom) | `--breakpoint-sheet` 37.5em (600 px: below it panels are bottom sheets, Q-13; at or above it plans go to two columns), `--breakpoint-wide` 64em (1024 px: three plan columns, wider form) |
| Motion | durations and easings: ADR-0013 |

#### 7. Icons (C1)

- Package: **`@lucide/angular` `1.77.0`**, licence **ISC**, peer `@angular/core >=17.0.0` and
  `@angular/common >=17.0.0` (satisfied by 22.3.0), `sideEffects: false`, unpacked 20.9 MB
  (registry; npm view, 2026-11-21). Each icon is its own standalone component with an attribute
  selector on `<svg>` (`LucideIdCard` → `svg[lucideIdCard]`), imported one by one in the component
  that uses it. The icons render through template bindings (`[attr.d]`, `@for`), not `innerHTML`
  (packed `fesm2022/lucide-angular.mjs`). With no `title` input the icon gets
  `aria-hidden="true"` automatically (`hasA11yProp: title != null` → `aria-hidden`), and we never
  pass `title`, so no icon adds accessible text or `textContent` (BR-04).
- Icon sizes and colours come from CSS tokens (`width`/`height: var(--size-icon)`,
  `color: currentColor`), not from the `size` input.
- **Field-key map** (`frontend/src/app/shared/field-icons.ts`, a pure map plus
  `iconForField(config)`; names verified as exports of `@lucide/angular@1.77.0`):

  | Field key | Icon | Field key | Icon |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `documentType` | `LucideIdCard` | `plate` | `LucideRectangleHorizontal` |
  | `documentNumber` | `LucideHash` | `make` | `LucideCar` |
  | `fullName` | `LucideUser` | `model` | `LucideCarFront` |
  | `birthDate` | `LucideCalendar` | `vehicleYear` | `LucideCalendarRange` |
  | `city` | `LucideMapPin` | **any other** `text`/`number`/`select`/`date` key | `LucidePencilLine` (default) |
  | `checkbox` fields | none | | |

- Other icons: help `LucideInfo`, error `LucideCircleAlert`, success and list items
  `LucideCircleCheck`, select chevron `LucideChevronDown`, selected option `LucideCheck`, search
  `LucideSearch`, close `LucideX`, months `LucideChevronLeft`/`LucideChevronRight`, date button
  `LucideCalendarDays`, processing `LucideLoaderCircle`, unknown-country fallback `LucideEarth`,
  step indicator `LucideUserRound` / `LucideShieldCheck` / `LucideReceipt`. Avoid
  `credit-card`-style names and any class or file named `…card…` in `.ts`/`.html` of files without
  the "no se realiza ningún cobro" copy: the US-03-AC-15 guard (`/tarjeta|\bcard\b/i`) would fail.
- **Bundle impact, measured** (production build of a copy of `frontend/` at HEAD in a temporary
  directory, `@angular/build` 22.3.0; baseline initial `main` 381.44 kB raw / 98.94 kB transfer):
  1 icon +11.33 kB raw / +2.26 kB transfer; 22 icons +78.24 kB raw / **+4.20 kB** transfer. Each
  icon compiles its own copy of the shared template (about 3.2 kB raw each), which compresses
  well. ADR-0012 keeps the initial bundle under the 500 kB warning by lazy-loading step 1.

#### 8. Flags

Our own SVGs, one standalone component per flag under `frontend/src/app/shared/flags/`, written by
hand from the published constructions (no library): Colombia 2:3, three horizontal bands 2:1:1
yellow/blue/red; Chile 2:3, two equal bands white over red, a blue square canton the height of the
white band, a white five-pointed star centred in the canton on a circle whose diameter is half the
canton side (Wikipedia, "Flag of Colombia" and "Flag of Chile", read 2026-11-21; neither law fixes
exact colours, so the colour values are the published approximations, ADR-0011). Each is `viewBox`
geometry only (`rect`, one `polygon`), fills from component tokens through CSS classes (no hex in
templates), `aria-hidden="true"`, `focusable="false"`, no `<title>`, no text; under 1 kB of
template each. A 1 px `--color-border-control` ring (4.23:1 on the header) separates the dark blue
areas from the near-black background. Where the flags appear and what replaces them for other
countries: ADR-0011.

### Consequences

- Good, because every value has one home and one name; the guard makes "no loose values" a gate
  failure, not a review comment (D1), at zero dependency cost (D8).
- Good, because the contrast proof is a test over the real token file: a tuned colour that breaks a
  pair fails the gate, gradients included (D2).
- Good, because the semantic tier isolates components from raw values: a light theme or a palette
  change touches `tokens.css` only.
- Good, because the icon package is the maintained one, compatible with Angular 22.3.0, hides
  icons by default and has no `innerHTML` path (D5, D6); the transfer cost of 22 icons is about
  4 kB.
- Good, because both fonts are OFL-1.1, same-origin, and the text face is chosen for the exact
  data the form collects.
- Bad, because a regex-based CSS guard is weaker than a real parser: a construct it does not
  anticipate (a value split across lines, an escape) could slip through — mitigation: the style
  files are small and simple; the sensitivity self-test covers each rule; the code-reviewer still
  reads the CSS; A2 remains the upgrade path.
- Bad, because `@lucide/angular` costs about 3.2 kB **raw** per icon (each icon is a component), so
  the raw initial size grows faster than the transfer size — mitigation: icons used only on step 1
  move to the lazy chunk (ADR-0012); budgets are measured on every build.
- Bad, because the Archivo width-axis file is 90 kB, about 55 kB more than its weight-only file
  (`archivo-latin-wght-normal.woff2`, 34,928 bytes) — mitigation: not preloaded, `swap`, used only
  for headings and prices, cached after the first visit; if HC2 prefers bytes over the width
  treatment, switching to the weight-only file is a one-line change.
- Bad, because a 3:1 border on every interactive card and input is heavier than the "thin, subtle"
  borders of the reference — mitigation: 1 px width, and subtle hairlines stay on non-interactive
  panels only (*Spec impact* 2).
- Neutral: the dark-only theme means users with a light-mode preference get the dark UI; that is
  the brief.

### Strongest argument against

Stylelint (A2) is the standard tool for exactly this rule: it parses CSS with PostCSS, reports
the line and column in the editor while the developer types, has a maintained
`declaration-strict-value` plugin, and `stylelint-config-standard` would catch a whole class of
other CSS mistakes for free. A home-made regex guard re-implements a parser badly, will drift as
the CSS grows, and gives feedback only when the test suite runs. Adding two pinned, MIT-licensed
devDependencies is a small price for that.

**Why we accept it:** the rule set here is narrow and project-specific (tier prefixes, "no
primitive in components", breakpoints that must equal token values, a single declaring file), so
Stylelint would need custom rules or plugin configuration for most of it anyway, plus a lint-step
change. The repository already enforces ADR rules as Vitest static guards that run in the gate
(ADR-0008, ADR-0009), and the sensitivity self-test makes a silent pass visible. If the guard
proves brittle during implementation or review, A2 is a contained switch: add the two
devDependencies through a superseding note and delete the guard.

### Confirmation

9	# ADR-0010: Design tokens and visual language (theme, palette, type, scales, icons, flags)
10	
11	## Context and Problem Statement
12	
13	US-04 redesigns every page of the wizard on a tokenized design system (`specs/US-04/spec.md` §1,
14	BR-01..BR-04, BR-12). Today the front end has twelve colour custom properties in `styles.css`
15	and literal lengths, colours and fonts spread over six component style files. The story asks for
16	tokens in one file in three tiers with no loose values in components, AA contrast proven over
17	gradients and a dotted texture, two self-hosted font families, one icon library imported icon by
18	icon, and flags. The human's visual direction (spec "Sources") pins the look: a deep near-black
19	background with a subtle dotted texture, a violet/indigo accent, a recommended plan card with a
20	vertical violet gradient and a soft glow, rounded cards with thin borders, pill segmented
21	controls, check-circle icons in lists, large bold display headings and high-contrast light
22	primary buttons. The story's first deliverable is this proposal with an example palette and type
23	scale (story, "First deliverable"). This ADR decides the token architecture and how it is
24	enforced, the theme (US-04-Q-01), the palette and its contrast proof (Q-03), the type (Q-08), the
25	scales, the icon library and field-key map (Q-09) and the flag assets (Q-10). Where the flags and
26	the per-country accent come from, and how that squares with ADR-0001, is ADR-0011.
27	
28	## Decision Drivers
29	
30	- D1. One token file, three tiers, no loose values in components, checked automatically
31	  (US-04-BR-01, US-04-AC-01; CLAUDE.md §9: "checked mechanically").
32	- D2. WCAG 2.2 AA: 4.5:1 text, 3:1 large text, UI component boundaries, focus indicators and
33	  meaningful icons, at every gradient stop and over the texture (US-04-BR-02, US-04-AC-02; story
34	  rules "AA contrast"). The pair list must be machine-readable so the test does not guess (AC-02
35	  note).
36	- D3. The human's visual direction above is the brief. CLAUDE.md §5 (`frontend-design`
37	  overrides): "the brief's words win, including when the approved direction matches one of the
38	  skill's generated defaults"; no aesthetic risk beyond the accepted ADR; the wizard is a task flow.
39	- D4. At most two font families, self-hosted, WOFF2, `font-display: swap`, at most the weights the
40	  type scale uses, no third-party origin at runtime (US-04-BR-12, US-04-AC-19; ADR-0002: the
41	  browser talks only to its own origin).
42	- D5. One icon library, icons imported one by one, no icon font, no runtime fetch, decorative icons
43	  hidden; exact version, permissive licence, compatible with `@angular/core` 22.3.0 (US-04-BR-04,
44	  BR-14; CLAUDE.md §4).
45	- D6. No `innerHTML` anywhere in the front end (ADR-0009; `static-guards.spec.ts`, US-03-AC-13;
46	  spec §9 "no `innerHTML` for icons or flags").
47	- D7. Bundle budgets of `angular.json` (initial 500 kB warning / 1 MB error; component style 4 kB
48	  warning / 8 kB error) are kept or a change is justified (spec §9, Performance).
49	- D8. Few new dependencies, each pinned exactly, licence reviewed (US-04-BR-14; CLAUDE.md §4).
50	
51	## Considered Options
52	
53	Four sub-decisions, each with its own options. The chosen one is marked.
54	
55	**A. Enforcing "no loose values"**
56	
57	1. **A1. A static-guard test in Vitest** (chosen) that reads the style files, like the existing
58	   `static-guards.spec.ts` of ADR-0008 and ADR-0009.
59	2. **A2. Stylelint** `18.1.0` with `stylelint-declaration-strict-value` `1.13.0` (both MIT), pinned
60	   devDependencies, run by `npm run lint`.
61	
62	**B. Theme (US-04-Q-01)**
63	
64	1. **B1. Dark only** (chosen), `color-scheme: dark`; semantic tokens structured so a light theme can
65	   be added later by redefining the semantic tier.
66	2. **B2. Dark and light following `prefers-color-scheme`**, no switch.
67	
68	**C. Icon library (US-04-Q-09)**
69	
70	1. **C1. `@lucide/angular` `1.77.0`** (chosen): one standalone component per icon.
71	2. **C2. `@ng-icons/core` `36.1.0` + `@ng-icons/lucide` `36.1.0`**: one generic `<ng-icon>` and
72	   icon SVG strings registered by name.
73	3. **C3. `lucide-angular` `1.0.0`**, the package the story names (verified non-viable, see below).
74	
75	**D. Font families (US-04-Q-08)**
76	
77	1. **D1. Archivo (display, width axis) + Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (text)** (chosen).
78	2. **D2. One family only**: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for everything.
79	3. **D3. The spec's starting candidates**: "Sora" or "Space Grotesk" + "Inter".
80	
81	## Decision Outcome
82	
83	Chosen options: **A1 static guard, B1 dark only, C1 `@lucide/angular@1.77.0`, D1 Archivo +
84	Atkinson Hyperlegible Next**, because they meet D1–D8 with **three** new runtime dependencies
85	(one icon package, two font packages) and no new tooling. A1 extends a guard pattern the gate
86	already runs. B1 is the brief. C1 is the maintained Angular package of the library the story
87	proposes, renders through template bindings (D6) and hides icons by default. D1 grounds the type
88	in the subject: plates, RUT and document numbers need unambiguous glyphs, and the display face
89	comes from a Latin American foundry with a width axis that makes the bold display headings of
90	the brief a deliberate treatment, not a default.
91	
92	### What is decided
93	
94	#### 1. Files and tiers
95	
96	| File | Holds | Rule |
97	|---|---|---|
98	| `frontend/src/styles/tokens.css` | Every custom property of the app, the two `@font-face` rules, the `prefers-reduced-motion` and country-accent overrides of tokens (ADR-0011, ADR-0013) | The **only** file that declares a custom property (`--…:`) or `@font-face`. Listed first in `angular.json` `styles`. |
99	| `frontend/src/styles/contrast-pairs.json` | The AC-02 pair list (format in §4) | Read by the contrast test; never by the app. |
100	| `frontend/src/styles.css` | Reset, element defaults, focus style, utility classes (`.visually-hidden`) | Semantic and component tokens only. |
101	| component `*.css` | Component styles | Semantic and component tokens only; no primitive. |
102	
103	Tier prefixes (the guard keys on them):
104	
105	| Tier | Prefix | Examples | Who may reference it |
106	|---|---|---|---|
107	| Primitive | `--primitive-` | `--primitive-violet-400`, `--primitive-ink-950` | `tokens.css` only |
108	| Semantic | `--color-`, `--font-`, `--text-`, `--leading-`, `--tracking-`, `--weight-`, `--space-`, `--size-`, `--radius-`, `--border-`, `--shadow-`, `--gradient-`, `--texture-`, `--duration-`, `--ease-`, `--z-`, `--breakpoint-`, `--focus-` | `--color-text-muted`, `--space-4`, `--duration-base` | any style file |
109	| Component | `--component-<name>-` | `--component-button-primary-bg`, `--component-plan-recommended-gradient` | any style file |
110	
111	Value forms allowed **inside `tokens.css`** (so the contrast test can resolve every pair without
112	a CSS engine): primitives are 6-digit hex (`#RRGGBB`); a translucent colour is
113	`color-mix(in srgb, var(--primitive-…) N%, transparent)`; a gradient is
114	`linear-gradient(<angle>deg, var(--…) P%, …)` or, for the texture only,
115	`radial-gradient(...)` of one translucent colour token; everything else is a `var()` or a length,
116	number, duration or `cubic-bezier()`.
117	
118	#### 2. "No loose values": the static guard (A1)
119	
120	A Vitest spec (extending `frontend/src/app/static-guards.spec.ts` or a new `design-guards.spec.ts`,
121	test-engineer's choice) reads every `*.css` under `frontend/src` and asserts, with comments
122	stripped:
123	
124	- Only `tokens.css` contains a custom-property declaration or `@font-face`.
125	- Outside `tokens.css`, no hex colour, `rgb(`/`rgba(`/`hsl(`/`hwb(`/`lab(`/`lch(`/`oklab(`/`oklch(`/
126	  `color-mix(`, no named colour other than `transparent`, `currentColor`, `inherit` and the
127	  `forced-colors` system colours (`Canvas`, `CanvasText`, `LinkText`, `Highlight`,
128	  `HighlightText`, `ButtonText`, `ButtonFace`, `GrayText`); no `font-family` value other than
129	  `var(--…)` or `inherit`; no `px`/`rem`/`em`/`ch`/`vw`/`vh` length outside `@media`/`@container`
130	  conditions; no `ms`/`s` duration, `cubic-bezier(`, gradient function, `box-shadow`/`text-shadow`
131	  literal or numeric `z-index`. Allowed literals: those listed in US-04-BR-01.
132	- No component style file references `--primitive-`.
133	- Every length in a `@media`/`@container` condition equals one `--breakpoint-*` value of
134	  `tokens.css`, and only `min-width` is used (mobile-first, US-04-BR-11), except the
135	  `prefers-reduced-motion`, `forced-colors` and `prefers-color-scheme` media features.
136	- A sensitivity self-test: a fixture string with one violation of each kind must be reported
137	  (the guard must not pass by finding nothing). Same idea as the "the guard looks at something"
138	  test of US-03-AC-13.
139	
140	Third-party CSS that Angular libraries inject themselves (the CDK overlay styles, ADR-0012) is not
141	in `frontend/src` and is out of the guard's scope; our overrides of it live in `styles.css` and
142	use tokens.
143

147	semantic tier is the only one components see, so a later light theme redefines semantic tokens
148	in one block of `tokens.css` and needs its own contrast rows; nothing in components changes.
