20	motion is applied and tested (US-04-Q-14, Q-16).
21	
22	## Decision Drivers
23	
24	- D1. No movement under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: every computed animation and transition
25	  duration 0 s and no running animation (US-04-BR-10, AC-17).
26	- D2. One page in the DOM during a step change, focus on the arriving `h1`, document title as today
27	  (US-04-AC-14; ADR-0001 "Focus on step change"; ADR-0009 heading outline).
28	- D3. Bundle weight and maintenance justified (story); budgets kept (spec §9); exact versions and a
29	  permissive licence for anything new (US-04-BR-14).
30	- D4. Animate `transform` and `opacity` only (spec §9, Performance).
31	- D5. Durations and easings are tokens (US-04-BR-01, ADR-0010).
32	- D6. Motion never interferes with announcements: role `alert`/`status` text is in the DOM at once
33	  (spec §8; US-04-Q-16: no counting-up of numbers).
34	- D7. Restraint: motion answers a person's action; one orchestrated moment beats scattered effects
35	  (vendored `frontend-design` skill, adopted with CLAUDE.md §5 overrides).
36	
37	## Considered Options
38	
39	1. **A. Native `animate.enter` / `animate.leave` + CSS keyframes and transitions** on duration and
40	   easing tokens; no animation library.
41	2. **B. Router `withViewTransitions()`** (View Transitions API) for the step change, plus CSS for
42	   everything else.
43	3. **C. An animation library**: Motion (`motion` 14.14.0) or GSAP (`gsap` 3.15.1), driven from
44	   `(animate.enter)` / `(animate.leave)` callbacks.
45	
46	## Decision Outcome
47	
48	Chosen option: **"A. Native `animate.enter` + CSS on tokens"**, because it costs zero bytes and no
49	dependency (D3), is stable public API in 22.3.0, covers every effect the spec lists with
50	`transform` and `opacity` (D4), and lets reduced motion be guaranteed by construction rather than by
51	overrides (D1). An enter-only page animation keeps exactly one page in the DOM (D2). B covers only
52	route changes, so it would be a second mechanism next to A, and it became public API only in this
53	very version. C adds 71–74 kB raw per library for effects CSS already does, and GSAP's licence is
54	not an OSI licence.
55	
56	### What is decided
57	
58	#### 1. Motion tokens (in `tokens.css`, ADR-0010)
59	
60	| Token | Value | Used for |
61	|---|---|---|
62	| `--duration-fast` | 120ms | hover, press, focus ring, error fade-in, panel close (exits are faster than entries) |
63	| `--duration-base` | 200ms | step enter, panel open, bottom-sheet slide, indicator fill, segmented control |
64	| `--duration-slow` | 320ms | confirmation check-circle; upper bound of any single transition (AC-14) |
65	| `--delay-stagger-1` … `--delay-stagger-4` | 0ms, 50ms, 100ms, 150ms | summary sections (total ≤ 150 + 200 = 350 ms, under Q-16's 400 ms) |
66	| `--duration-shimmer` | 1400ms | skeleton shimmer loop |
67	| `--duration-spin` | 800ms | "Pagar" processing spinner |
68	| `--ease-out` | `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)` | entries |
69	| `--ease-in` | `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)` | exits |
70	| `--ease-standard` | `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` | state changes (colour, border, glow) |
71	| `--motion-rise` | 0.5rem (8 px) | step enter and panel offset |
72	
73	No bounce or overshoot curves. Under `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` every `--duration-*`
74	and `--delay-*` token is `0ms` (a second line of defence; see §3).
75	
76	#### 2. Where motion is used (and where it is not)
77	
78	| Effect | Mechanism | Property |
79	|---|---|---|
80	| Step change | `animate.enter="page-enter"` on the root element of each routed page; **no** `animate.leave` | opacity 0 → 1, translateY(`--motion-rise`) → 0, `--duration-base`, `--ease-out` |
81	| Step indicator fill | CSS transition on the progress bar | `transform: scaleX()` |
82	| Select panel open | `animate.enter` on the panel | opacity, translateY(−`--motion-rise`/2) |
83	| Bottom sheet open | `animate.enter` on the sheet | translateY(100%) → 0 |
84	| Panel close | instant by default; `animate.leave` only if the developer confirms it runs when the CDK overlay detaches (no AC needs it) | opacity |
85	| Error text | `animate.enter="error-enter"` | opacity only (no shake); the text is in the DOM, inside `role="alert"`, from the first frame (D6) |
86	| Hover / active / chosen plan | CSS transitions | `border-color`, `box-shadow`, `background-color` (paint), and a 2 px lift on hover only for `(hover: hover)` pointers |
87	| Skeleton shimmer | keyframes on a pseudo-element | `transform: translateX()` |
88	| "Pagar" spinner | keyframes on the icon | `transform: rotate()` |
89	| Summary sections | `animate.enter` with `--delay-stagger-n` by `:nth-of-type` | opacity, translateY |
90	| Confirmation | `animate.enter` on the check-circle | scale 0.85 → 1 and opacity, `--duration-slow` (the single orchestrated moment of the flow) |
91	
92	Not animated: prices and numbers (no counting up, D6), headings, the country chooser list, text in
93	live regions. Hover transitions are colour and shadow changes, not motion, except the 2 px lift
94	(D7: "hover transitions on every card" read as generated; the plan cards are the one place where a
95	lift explains "this is clickable", US-04-BR-09).
96	
97	**Step transition, why one page only.** The router removes the leaving component and inserts the
98	arriving one in the same change; with no `animate.leave`, Angular does not keep the old element.
99	Only the arriving page animates in, so there is never a second `h1` or `main` (AC-14). Focus moves
100	to the arriving `h1` as today: opacity and transform do not affect focus or the accessibility tree.
101	
102	#### 3. Reduced motion, by construction (D1)
103	
104	- In every style file except `tokens.css`, each `animation`, `animation-*`, `transition` and
105	  `transition-*` declaration sits inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { … }`.
106	  Under `reduce` no animation or transition is declared at all: computed durations are the initial
107	  `0s`, `document.getAnimations()` is empty, and states (colour, border, icon, text) still change,
108	  instantly. This keeps feedback while removing movement, a principle restated from
109	  `pbakaus/impeccable` `animate.md` (Apache-2.0, credited per EVAL-004), and it avoids the global
110	  `0.01ms !important` kill switch that the same source flags.
111	- `animate.enter` classes therefore have no animation under `reduce`; Angular reads the computed
112	  styles, finds none, and removes the class at once (`@angular/core@22.3.0`
113	  `determineLongestAnimation` falls back to computed styles when `getAnimations()` is empty;
114	  `MAX_ANIMATION_TIMEOUT` default 4000 ms is never reached).
115	- The duration tokens are also set to `0ms` under `reduce` in `tokens.css`, so a declaration that
116	  escapes the `no-preference` block still has no duration.
117	- **CDK overlays and dialogs** (ADR-0012) are created with `disableAnimations: true`. The CDK's own
118	  backdrop has `transition: opacity 400ms` and, under reduced motion, `transition-duration: 1ms`
119	  (`@angular/cdk@22.3.0` overlay styles), which would fail AC-17's "0s"; with
120	  `disableAnimations`, the CDK adds `cdk-overlay-backdrop-noop-animation` (`transition: none`). Our
121	  own backdrop fade, if any, is a token transition inside the `no-preference` block in
122	  `styles.css`.
123	- The spinner stops under `reduce`; "Procesando pago…" (US-03) remains the feedback.
124	
125	#### 4. Tests (AC-14, AC-17)
126	
127	- **Static guard** (extends ADR-0010's guard): outside `tokens.css`, no `animation`/`transition`
128	  declaration outside a `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` block; durations, delays and
129	  easings only as `var(--duration-*)`, `var(--delay-*)`, `var(--ease-*)`; `tokens.css` sets every
130	  `--duration-*` and `--delay-*` to `0ms` under `reduce`; every `createOverlayRef`,
131	  `cdkConnectedOverlay` and `Dialog.open` call passes `disableAnimations: true` (a grep on the
132	  production sources).
133	- **E2E AC-17**: a Playwright context with `reducedMotion: 'reduce'` walks step 1 (with "Ciudad"
134	  open and the calendar open), step 2, the summary and the confirmation; on each state it asserts
135	  that every element's computed `animationDuration` and `transitionDuration` list only `0s`, and
136	  `document.getAnimations()` is empty.
137	- **E2E AC-14**: with motion allowed, a `MutationObserver` installed before "Continuar" records the
138	  maximum number of `h1` and `main` elements seen during navigation (expected 1 and 1); then focus
139	  is on "Elige tu plan" and the title is unchanged; the page's enter animation reports a duration
140	  ≤ `--duration-slow` through `getAnimations()`.
141	
142	### Consequences
143	
144	- Good, because no dependency, no bytes, no licence question (D3); `animate.enter` is
145	  `@publicApi 20.2` in `@angular/core@22.3.0` and the vendored skill's own guidance for v20.2+.
146	- Good, because reduced motion is a property of how styles are written, enforced by a guard, not a
147	  late override that can be missed (D1).
148	- Good, because one page is ever in the DOM (D2), and focus and announcements are untouched (D6).
149	- Bad, because the old page disappears without an exit animation, so the change is a cut followed by
150	  a fade-in, less fluid than a cross-fade — mitigation: the fade is short (200 ms) and the step
151	  indicator fill gives continuity; B can be added later as an enhancement if the human wants a
152	  cross-fade (see *Revisit*).
153	- Bad, because closing a panel inside a CDK overlay may not run `animate.leave` (the overlay detaches
154	  its content) — mitigation: panels close instantly unless the developer proves the leave runs; no
155	  AC requires a close animation.
156	- Bad, because writing every animation inside a media block is a discipline — mitigation: the guard
157	  fails the gate otherwise.
158	- Neutral: the first page load also plays `page-enter` once; that is the single page-load moment.
159	
160	### Strongest argument against
161	
162	The View Transitions route (B) gives a real two-state transition with one line,
163	`withViewTransitions()`: the browser snapshots the old page and cross-fades it into the new one,
164	while the live DOM still holds only the new page (so AC-14 holds too). It can even morph the step
165	indicator between steps with a `view-transition-name`, which is the "animated step indicator" the
166	story asks for, and browsers without support simply skip it. Enter-only CSS is a hard cut followed
167	by a fade, the kind of generic "fade-and-rise" the `frontend-design` skill calls a tell of generated
168	pages.
169	
170	**Why we accept it:** B only animates route changes, so the panels, errors, skeletons, cards,
171	spinner and confirmation still need A: two mechanisms, two reduced-motion paths (B also needs
172	`skipTransition()` or `::view-transition-*` rules under `reduce`, and its pseudo-element
173	animations show up in `document.getAnimations()` during AC-17). `withViewTransitions` is tagged
174	`@publicApi 22.3` in the 22.3.0 typings, so it has been public API only since the release we pin,
175	three days before this ADR. The fade-in here is brief and paired with the indicator fill, and the
176	one orchestrated moment is the confirmation, as the skill advises. B stays a contained later
177	enhancement on top of A.
178	
179	### Confirmation
180	
181	- Static guard rules of §4 (US-04-AC-17, AC-01).
182	- E2E `us-04-design-system.spec.ts`: AC-14 and AC-17 as in §4.
183	- Component tests (AC-15): skeletons are `aria-hidden`, the loading text stays in its live region.
184	- HC3: the human checks the motion with the OS setting on and off (AC-23).
185	- `frontend/package.json` contains no `motion`, `gsap`, `@angular/animations` or other animation
186	  dependency (dependency list guard of ADR-0010).
187	
188	## Pros and Cons of the Options
189

### Implementation notes on accepted ADRs (no decision change)

Accepted ADRs are not rewritten. When the implementation of an accepted decision changes in a way
that leaves the decision intact, the note goes here.

| ADR | Note | Since |
|---|---|---|
| 0002 | The published-only rule (ADR-0002 calls it a "global middleware") is a **route middleware** on `find`/`findOne`, attached per router through `publishedOnlyConfig()`, so that it runs after Strapi authentication. The decision (no drafts for any unauthenticated read) is unchanged. A backend test guards that every content router uses it. | c3bdb56, 345a016 (US-01-R1-F01); US-01-R2-F06 |
| 0001 | **Summary route registered by US-02 (US-02-Q-03, HC1 2026-11-21).** The route table row `/:country/resumen` keeps its address and its kind of guard; only *who builds it, and when* moves forward. US-02 registers `/:country/resumen` with **no component** (`children: []`, the same pattern ADR-0001 used for `/:country/planes` in US-01) and a `CanActivateFn` step 3 guard, defined in US-02 spec (US-02-AC-15): no valid step 1 for the route's country → `RedirectCommand` to `/<country>/datos`; no chosen plan, or a stored plan key that is not an offered plan of this page load → `RedirectCommand` to `/<country>/planes`; both with `replaceUrl: true`. US-03 attaches its page to that route without changing the address or the guard, and may extend the guard only through its own spec. No new decision: ADR-0001 fixed the addresses, the per-step guards, the `RedirectCommand`/`replaceUrl` mechanics and the "earlier story registers the route, later story attaches the page" pattern; it left the guard's content to a story spec. | US-02 spec v0.1 (US-02-Q-03, US-02-AC-15) |
| 0002 | **Terms content-type name (US-03-Q-03, HC1 2026-11-21).** ADR-0002 names the US-03 permission `api::terms.terms.find`. Strapi 5.63.0 refuses a content type whose singular and plural names are equal (`@strapi/core@5.63.0` `dist/loaders/apis.js:44-62`, `validateContentTypesUnicity`: "The plural name … should be unique"), so the type is **`api::term.term`** (singularName `term`, pluralName `terms`, as in CLAUDE.md §6). Consequently: the public permission is **`api::term.term.find`** (no `findOne`), reconciled in bootstrap with the existing three; the router is `createCoreRouter('api::term.term', publishedOnlyConfig())` with a fresh config object (US-01-R2-F03), so `backend/tests/published-only-routes.test.ts` covers it; the REST path stays **`/api/terms`**, which must be added to the GET-only allow-list in `frontend/nginx/default.conf.template` (today `countries|form-fields|plans`). The decision (public `find` only, published-only reads, GET-only proxy, no write token in the browser) is unchanged. | US-03 spec v0.1 (US-03-Q-03, §7.4) |
| 0004 | The submit gate is Signal Forms validity, as decided: `submission.action` runs only for a valid form, and `onInvalid` focuses the first invalid field in `sortOrder` with `focusBoundControl()`. A native `number`/`date` input the browser cannot read gets a Signal Forms `parse` error, and its control model is deliberately left unwritten (writing `''` would erase the visible text). The store therefore follows the control: `syncNative` is the only writer of number and date keys (`''` on `validity.badInput`), and `flushModel()` writes the other types before `completeStep1` (keyboard Enter). 40606e2 had moved the gate to the store with `ignoreValidators: 'all'`, which broke the AC-24 keyboard submit (patched in e92e2c7) and let an emptied date through (US-01-R3-F01). The human chose to restore the Signal Forms gate in eeb23e6. | e92e2c7, eeb23e6 (US-01-R3-F01, R3-F05); US-01-R3-F02 |
| 0003 | **An empty wizard state is represented by no `quote-wizard` entry (US-03-R1-F02).** A state with no step 1 values and no chosen plan leaves no entry in `sessionStorage`. a3f186c added this to `QuoteStore.persist()` as an early `return`, which only skipped the write: an entry that already existed stayed, for example after `prune()` drops every stored key because none is configured any more, so the values of removed fields remained in the tab. b3fdd45 (US-03-R1-F02) fixed it: for an empty state, `persist()` (`frontend/src/app/core/quote-store.ts:163-178`, empty branch `:169-172`) now **removes** any existing entry by calling `clearStorage()` (call on `:170`, method `:180-186`) and then returns, so the invariant "empty state ⇒ no entry" holds in every case, and ADR-0003's "the pruned state is written back" is met by removal when the pruned state is empty (`prune()`, `:88-98`). Consequences: entering a country with an empty step 1 (`enterCountry`, `:42-51`) no longer writes `{country, step1: {values: {}}}`, a change to US-01 behaviour; nothing is lost, because the country is always known from the `/:country` route, which calls `enterCountry` on each entry (ADR-0001), and the entry is written on the first value or plan choice. After a successful payment, `clearQuote()` (`:58-64`) removes the entry, and a reload, a back action or "Nueva cotización" re-enters the country with an empty state, so no entry is found (US-03-AC-11). The decision of ADR-0003 (one versioned `sessionStorage` entry per tab, scoped to one country, cleared on country change and on successful payment) is unchanged. | a3f186c; b3fdd45 (US-03-R1-F02) |
| 0012 | **First day of the calendar week comes from the locale (human decision at HC1, 2026-11-21; spec v0.2, ece558e: US-04-BR-06, US-04-AC-09).** ADR-0012 §4 says "columns Monday first" and "Home/End to Monday/Sunday of the week". Instead, the grid's first column is the first day of the week of the current country's locale tag (Strapi `country`, ADR-0001/ADR-0006) from CLDR through `Intl`: Sunday for `es-CO`, Monday for `es-CL`. Home and End move to the first and last day of that locale's week. The date picker holds no country code and no per-country table: it receives the locale tag and derives the day. **How:** `new Intl.Locale(tag).getWeekInfo().firstDay` (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday). If the method is missing, use the older `weekInfo` accessor. If neither exists, fall back to **Monday** (CLDR's world default, `und-001`). This is a pure function next to `calendar-dates.ts`, with the clock and locale injectable. **Runtime support:** MDN browser-compat-data gives `getWeekInfo` in Chrome 130, Firefox 153, Safari 17 and Node 24.0.0, and the `weekInfo` accessor in Chrome 99 and Safari 15.4 (removed in Safari Technology Preview). Measured on 2026-11-21: Playwright's Chromium 159.0.8154.6 (the only e2e project) has `getWeekInfo` and no longer has `weekInfo`, giving `es-CO` 7 and `es-CL` 1; Node 24.22.1 (Vitest) has both, with the same values; `und-001` gives 1. Firefox and WebKit are not installed for Playwright and were not run. **Fallback effect:** on browsers with neither API (Firefox before 153, Safari before 15.4, Chrome before 99), Colombia shows Monday first. `@angular/common`'s `getLocaleFirstDayOfWeek` is not used: it is `@deprecated 18.0` in 22.3.0 ("Angular recommends relying on the `Intl` API"), and it needs `registerLocaleData` for `es-CO`/`es-CL`, which the app does not register. The rest of ADR-0012 (primitives, binding, keyboard keys, disabled days) is unchanged. | Spec v0.2 (ece558e); HC1 2026-11-21 |

# US-04 step 3 report: tests written, red, committed

Commit `4d75937` on `feat/us-04-design-system` (`test(us-04): …`, Refs and Co-Authored-By trailers). Nothing pushed, no branch switch, no background commands. The pre-commit hook passed. The tree is clean after the commit. I touched only test files, `frontend/src/testing/**`, `frontend/e2e/**` and `specs/US-04/tasks.md` (T-07..T-15 and the status block). No production file changed.

## 1. Files mapped to IDs

**Static guards**
- `frontend/src/app/design-guards.spec.ts` (57 tests) covers AC-01/BR-01, AC-03 (country codes, `data-country-accent` selectors, flag components), AC-04 (no namespace or icon-module import of `@lucide/angular`), AC-17/BR-10 (reduced motion by construction, `disableAnimations`), AC-19/BR-12 (fonts), and AC-21/BR-14.
- The same file also checks the ADR-0012 import limits (`@angular/aria` only in `custom-select.ts` and `calendar.ts`) and the lazy `loadComponent` on `/:country/datos`.
- Every rule has a sensitivity self-test: one fixture per violation kind (16 kinds), a clean fixture of the allowed literals that must report nothing, and fixtures for the reduce tokens, the CDK call counts, the fonts and the exact-version regex.
- Helpers: `src/testing/css.ts` (CSS and token reader), `src/testing/design-guards.ts` (the pure checks).

**Contrast**
- `src/app/shared/contrast.spec.ts` covers AC-02/BR-02. The WCAG function has reference values (21:1, #777777 on white 4.48, the documented 18.18). The `var()` reader, the pair coverage, the minimums and the evaluation of every row also live here.
- Helper: `src/testing/contrast.ts`.

**Pure functions** (all in `src/app/shared/`)
- `date-text.spec.ts`: AC-08.
- `calendar-dates.spec.ts`: AC-09 and AC-10, including `firstDayOfWeek` with an injected fallback.
- `select-search.spec.ts`: AC-07.
- `field-icons.spec.ts`: AC-04.
- `country-visuals.spec.ts`: AC-03.

**Component tests**
- In `src/app/shared/`:
  - `custom-select.spec.ts` (47 tests): AC-05, AC-06 (every row on "Marca" searchable and on "Tipo de documento" select-only), AC-07.
  - `date-field.spec.ts` (55 tests): AC-08, AC-09, AC-10, BR-08.
  - `wizard-chrome.spec.ts` (20 tests): AC-13 and the header half of AC-03.
- `features/country/country-chooser-page.spec.ts` (new, 6 tests): AC-03 flags and the Perú fallback, AC-15.
- I appended AC-04/AC-15/AC-16/AC-20 blocks to `quote-form-page.spec.ts`, `plan-list-page.spec.ts` and `summary-page.spec.ts`. The summary spec also has AC-13 for the confirmation.
- Helpers: `src/testing/dom.ts` (updated), `src/testing/custom-controls.ts` (new).

**E2E**
- New `e2e/us-04-design-system.spec.ts` plus `e2e/support/design.ts`. It covers AC-05/06/07 (real keyboard), AC-08 (three browser locales), AC-09/10 (calendar keyboard, focus trap, backdrop, `aria-hidden`, week start), AC-11/BR-07, AC-12 (four panel rows), AC-14, AC-16, AC-17, AC-18/BR-11 (3 viewports × 2 countries × 8 pages), AC-19 and AC-20.
- Adapted per §11.1: `e2e/support/{form,plans}.ts`, `us-01-data-form-co`, `us-01-country-context`, `us-01-03-full-flow-co`, and `us-01-security` (only the leak list gains "15/05/1990").

## 2. `scripts/trace.sh US-04 --no-fail`

AC table (the Tests column is cut here to the new spec files for width; the script lists all of them):

| AC | Main test files | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 01, 02 | design-guards, contrast | tested |
| 03 | design-guards, country-chooser-page, country-visuals, wizard-chrome | tested |
| 04 | design-guards, field-icons, quote-form-page, plan-list-page, summary-page | tested |
| 05, 06, 07 | custom-select, select-search, e2e us-04 | tested |
| 08, 09, 10 | date-text, calendar-dates, date-field, e2e us-04 | tested |
| 11, 12, 14, 18 | e2e us-04 (11 also design-guards) | tested |
| 13 | wizard-chrome, summary-page | tested |
| 15, 16 | the four page specs, plan-list-page, e2e (16) | tested |
| 17, 19 | e2e us-04, design-guards | tested |
| 20, 21 | e2e us-04 and page specs; design-guards (21) | tested |
| 22, 23 | none | manual (per spec) |

Summary line: ACs without test: 0, open blocker/major findings: 0. BR-07/08/11/15/16 show "no direct test" or are covered through their ACs. I added BR-07, BR-08 and BR-11 to test titles after that run, so the next run should list them.

## 3. Red evidence

**Type check**
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.spec.json` prints exactly 5 lines, all TS2307, for `./calendar-dates`, `./country-visuals`, `./date-text`, `./field-icons` and `./select-search`. Nothing else.
- `ng test` for the whole suite fails at build with the same five unresolved modules (TS2307 and "Could not resolve"). Those 5 specs cannot be collected until the modules exist.

**Unit run**
- I ran the suite with those 5 files excluded: **1178 tests, 981 pass, 197 fail**, 9 files failing and 25 passing.
- The 981 passes include every unchanged pre-US-04 test, the negative guards and all the guard self-tests.
- `static-guards.spec.ts`: 11 of 11 pass.

| File | Fail / total | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| custom-select.spec.ts | 46 / 47 | no combobox exists ("expected 'SELECT' to be 'BUTTON'", "Activating the combobox did not open a listbox") |
| date-field.spec.ts | 55 / 55 | native date input (`expected '' to be '15/05/1990'`) |
| quote-form-page.spec.ts | 35 | see below |
| design-guards.spec.ts | 22 / 57 | ENOENT `tokens.css`, no `country-visuals.ts`, no `field-icons.ts`, no flags, no CDK call sites, `angular.json` and `index.html` lack the fonts, dependencies absent, step 1 not lazy |
| wizard-chrome.spec.ts | 18 / 20 | no header, no indicator, no `data-country-accent` |
| plan-list-page.spec.ts | 9 / 80 | 4 existing rewritten tests, 5 new |
| contrast.spec.ts | 5 / 15 | ENOENT `tokens.css` and `contrast-pairs.json` |
| country-chooser-page.spec.ts | 4 / 6 | no flags, no skeleton |
| summary-page.spec.ts | 3 / 116 | all new: no skeleton, no icons, no indicator on the confirmation |

- Of the 197 failures, 160 carry a US-04 ID in the title. The other 37 are the rewritten or extended existing-style tests (3 in design-guards, 30 in quote-form-page, 4 in plan-list-page) plus the 3 ADR-0012 confirmation guards in design-guards.
- **Why the rewritten tests fail**
  - Typing "15/05/1990" into the still-native date input leaves it empty, so a valid "Continuar" does not move on.

  - A date shows "1990-05-15" instead of "15/05/1990".

## 4. Public API and DOM contract the tests expect

**New modules and exports** (names from the ADRs, signatures mine, see ambiguity 2)
- `shared/date-text.ts`
  - `parseDateText(text): string | null`: `''` for blank, ISO for a valid date, `null` for unreadable text.

- `shared/calendar-dates.ts`
  - `firstDayOfWeek(localeTag, makeLocale?)`: 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday. Tries `getWeekInfo()`, then `weekInfo`, then 1. `makeLocale` defaults to `new Intl.Locale(tag)`.
  - `monthGrid(year, month1to12, localeTag)`: `{ weekdays: string[]; weeks: (isoString|null)[][] }`.
  - `nextFocusDate(iso, key, shift, localeTag)`: `key` is a KeyboardEvent.key; unknown keys are not tested.
  - `isDayDisabled(config, iso, today: Date)`, `latestValidDate(config, today)`, `yearRange(config, today): {from, to}`.

- `shared/select-search.ts`: `SEARCH_THRESHOLD = 4`, `normaliseForSearch`, `filterOptions(options, text)`.

- `shared/country-visuals.ts`: `countryVisuals(code): { flag: Type | null; accent: 'co' | 'cl' | null }`.
- `shared/flags/*.ts`, one standalone component per flag. Flag templates must be a single svg with `aria-hidden="true"`, `focusable="false"`, no `<title>` and no text.
- Production code outside `country-visuals.ts` may not contain the quoted `'CO'` or `'CL'`.
- `shared/custom-select.ts`, `shared/date-field.ts` and `shared/calendar.ts` carry no component-input contract. Tests reach them only through the step 1 page.

**Rules for production files**
- `@angular/aria` is imported only by `shared/custom-select.ts` and `shared/calendar.ts`.
- Production code imports `@lucide/angular` icon by icon: no `import * as`, no icon module, no `lucide-angular`, no `@ng-icons`.
- Overlays and dialogs: the file-level count of `disableAnimations: true` must be at least the count of call sites (`createOverlayRef(`, `overlay*.create(`, `dialog*.open(`, `cdkConnectedOverlay`), with at least 2 call sites in total.

**DOM**
- Select-only (fewer than 4 options): `<button role="combobox">`. Searchable: `<input type="text" role="combobox">` with `placeholder="Selecciona una opción"` and value `''` when empty.
- Both carry `aria-expanded`, `aria-required` and `aria-invalid`; the form-bound `aria-describedby` is kept.
- Both are reachable by `<label for>`. While open, `aria-controls` points to the `role="listbox"` and `aria-activedescendant` to the active `role="option"`.
- The popup renders under `document.body`. Selected options have `aria-selected="true"` and an `svg[aria-hidden]` check inside the option.
- No extra `<label>` in the page. The popup listbox is also labelled by the field label, so e2e `field()` now excludes non-input/button elements.
- Polite announcements ("1 opción", "N opciones", "No encontramos opciones para «xyz».") are text in any `[aria-live="polite"]` or `[role="status"]`, either the CDK LiveAnnouncer or the component's own.
- The empty-result text is also visible text in the document.
- Date field: `<input type="text">` with `placeholder="dd/mm/aaaa"`, and "Formato: dd/mm/aaaa" in its `aria-describedby`. A button named "Elegir fecha: <label>" (aria-label or text) follows it directly in the DOM, with `type="button"`.
- Calendar:
  - `role="dialog"` with `aria-modal="true"` and `aria-labelledby` pointing at the visible text "noviembre de 2008".
  - Buttons "Elegir año", "Mes anterior", "Mes siguiente", "Cerrar".
  - `role="grid"`; `role="columnheader"` cells expose the full day names through `aria-label`, `abbr[title]` or text.
  - `role="gridcell"` carries `aria-label="15 de mayo de 1990"`, `aria-selected` and `aria-disabled` itself. Focus sits on the cell or inside it; padding cells are siblings in the same row.
  - The year list is a `role="listbox"` of `role="option"` years with `aria-selected` on the current one.
- Page behind the dialog: the child of `<body>` that holds the page gets `aria-hidden="true"` while open and loses it after.
- Header: a `<header>` or `role="banner"` with the text "Cotizador de seguro de auto", the Strapi country name and an `svg[aria-hidden="true"][focusable="false"]`. No heading, link, button or other focusable element.
- Step indicator: an `ol`, `ul` or `role="list"` named "Progreso de la cotización" with 3 `li`.
  - The current step has `aria-current="step"` on the `li` or an element inside it, and the text "Paso n de 3".
  - Earlier steps contain the text "completado". On the confirmation all three do and nothing has `aria-current`.
  - It holds no focusable element, heading or link.
- Header and indicator must be rendered inside the routed tree, not only in `App`, because the harness hosts the routes.
- `data-country-accent="co|cl"` is set on some element of the document; none for a country with no visuals (document-wide query). Header and indicator are absent on `/` and on the unknown-country page.
- Icons: every `svg` inside `app.root` has `aria-hidden="true"`, no `tabindex`, no `<title>` and no text. Text, number, select and date fields show at least one svg in their field container. The checkbox shows none.
- Unmapped keys must render identical icon markup, different from every mapped key's.
- Plan lists: every `li` of the coverage and benefit lists contains an `svg[aria-hidden]`, and its text is unchanged.
- A click anywhere on a card (description, price, a list item) checks its radio, which stays native.
- Skeletons are `aria-hidden="true"` non-svg elements with no text. There must be more of them while loading than once loaded. The loading text stays a leaf element in a `role="status"` or `aria-live="polite"` region outside the hidden subtree, with `aria-busy` on the container.
- Heading outlines are exactly those of AC-20 (summary: h3 title, then terms body from h4 on).
- Chooser links: text exactly the country name, a flag svg inside (a globe for the Perú fixture), no `aria-label`.
- Tokens (`src/styles/tokens.css`, first in `angular.json` `styles`):
  - Prefixes: `--primitive-`, `--component-`, and the semantic ones of ADR-0010 §1 plus `--delay-` and `--motion-` (from ADR-0013).
  - Required families: `--color-`, `--font-`, `--text-`, `--space-`, `--radius-`, `--shadow-`, `--gradient-`, `--duration-`, `--ease-`, `--z-`, `--breakpoint-`.
  - Names the tests read: `--color-bg`, `--color-surface`, `--color-surface-raised`, `--color-text`, `--color-text-muted`, `--color-error`, `--color-focus`, `--color-border-control`, `--color-country-accent`, `--texture-dots`, `--duration-slow` (320ms).
  - `@font-face` only in `tokens.css`: Archivo `700 800`, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next `400 700`, one `url('/fonts/*.woff2') format('woff2')` each, `swap`.
  - `--font-*` tokens name only those two plus `system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif`.
  - `[data-country-accent='co']` and `='cl'` blocks.
  - Base `--duration-*` and `--delay-*` each set to `0ms` inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`.
- Colour forms in `tokens.css`: `#RRGGBB`, `color-mix(in srgb, #hex N%, transparent)` and `linear-gradient(...)` / `radial-gradient(...)` of those.
- `contrast-pairs.json` is an array of `{ id, fg, bg: string[], min, ac: "US-04-AC-02" }`.
  - A gradient token on either side expands to all its stops. `"texture-worst"` is the dot colour composited over `--color-bg`. `fg: "--color-country-accent"` is evaluated once with the brand default and once per accent block.
  - Required rows: fg `--color-text` and `--color-text-muted` over `--color-bg`, `texture-worst` and `--color-surface`; `--color-error`; `--color-focus` and `--color-border-control` (min 3) over `--color-bg` and `--color-surface`; `--color-country-accent` over bg, surface and `--color-surface-raised`; at least 2 rows over a multi-stop gradient with min ≥ 4.5; at least 1 row whose fg is a gradient with min ≥ 3.
  - Rows for text names may not set `min` below 4.5, nor UI names below 3.

## 5. Existing tests rewritten and why they are not weaker

**Helpers**
- `testing/dom.ts`
  - `allControls()` now selects `input, select, [role="combobox"]`.
  - `shownValue` reads the button text for a select-only and the input value for the rest. `''` for an empty searchable still passes the existing `['', false, PROMPT]` check in AC-22.
  - `choose` and `fillForm` are now async and use the open-then-click-option path of spec §11.1. `fillForm` types dates as dd/mm/aaaa.
  - New: `expectPrompt`, `press`, `typeKeys`, `openCombobox`, `clickOption`, `settleUi`, `listboxOf`, `optionTexts`.
- `seed-fixtures` and `plan-fixtures`: the date inputs are now "15/05/1990" and "20/03/1985". The `*_RAW` stored values are unchanged.
- The three page specs only gain `await` before `fillForm`.

**Component specs**
- All tests keep their titles and AC IDs. Wherever a native select or date was asserted, the new assertion checks what is shown and what is stored (`QuoteStore` or `sessionStorage`).
- AC-01 render test: now also asserts the date is a text box (not a combobox) plus the "Elegir fecha: …" button; the 3 selects are comboboxes with `aria-expanded` false then true and `aria-controls` equal to the rendered listbox.
- AC-07 options: now checks the open listbox contents and order, no selected option, no prompt option, and each of the 4 options stores BOG, MDE, CLO and BAQ (stronger than the old `o.value` list).
- AC-04 hydration and AC-23 stale select: shown value plus stored value (the old test checked only the select value).
- The `badInput` tests for optional and required dates now type real unreadable text ("10/13/2026", "15/05/199") and also assert the text stays visible and the focus is on the date box (new).

**E2E**
- `fillField` uses combobox → click → `getByRole('option', exact)` → assert shown.
- `expectEntered` asserts the shown value and the stored option value (select) or ISO value (date). The `aria-invalid` check is unchanged.
- `expectEmptyStep1`: each combobox shows the prompt (button text, or input `''` plus placeholder) and the stored value for its key is empty.
- The three US-03-AC-11 tests: the select-bearing one uses `expectFieldEmpty`; the two text-only ones are unchanged.
- The R3-F01 tests: no locale override; the date box loses its last digit with End and Backspace; Tab goes until the focus leaves the date field; the message, `aria-invalid`, the stored value not containing "1990-05-15" and the focus on the date are asserted as before, plus the text staying "15/05/199".
- AC-24 keyboard test: type, Enter, shown and stored for all 3 selects and the date; Tab order, Shift+Tab, focus indicators and Enter on "Continuar" are unchanged.
- The leak lists in the three flow tests also forbid "15/05/1990" now (stricter).
- Nothing was skipped, deleted or loosened.

## 6. Ambiguities and decisions for the orchestrator

1. **`parseDateText` return for unreadable text.** The ADR-0012 text says `null`; the task brief says "invalid → `''` with the text kept". I tested the ADR: `null` is unreadable, `''` is blank. The component maps `null` to a stored `''`.
2. **Signatures the ADRs leave open.**
   - `calendar-dates.ts` (locale tag instead of firstDay, ISO strings, `monthGrid` return shape, `firstDayOfWeek(tag, makeLocale?)`) and `iconForField` are mine.
   - The developer may rename, but then the 5 pure specs need updating.
3. **Per-country rows in `contrast-pairs.json`.** The ADR gives no shape. My convention: a row with `fg: "--color-country-accent"` is evaluated per accent block.
4. **Header, indicator and skeleton conventions** are test conventions (section 4). A skeleton "shape" is an `aria-hidden` non-svg empty element, so a decorative empty aria-hidden element on a ready page would count; the test only requires fewer shapes after loading. The spec has no accessible handle for skeletons.
5. **Select-only type-ahead with spaces.** §11.1 says to type "Cédula de c" and press Enter. Space on a select-only combobox chooses the active option when open, so the typed string passes through several choose cycles. It ends on "Cédula de ciudadanía" either way, but it depends on the exact implementation. I kept §11.1 verbatim.
6. **Space on a collapsed searchable.** Asserted as "keydown not default-prevented" in the component test and `toHaveValue(' ')` in e2e. Enter on a searchable input inside a form is asserted to open the list (no submit).
7. **jsdom limits.**
   - Tab does not move focus, so only "Tab commits and closes" is asserted there; the move to "Línea" is e2e.
   - Outside-click is simulated with pointerdown, mousedown, pointerup, mouseup and click.
   - Opening a combobox uses `focus()` + `click()` in the component helper (no ArrowDown fallback), which is exactly AC-05's "activate".
   - Option choice uses `option.click()`; whether `@angular/aria` picks it up in jsdom without a pointerdown is for the developer to prove.
8. **AC-14.**
   - The test requires at least one finite `getAnimations()` entry during the enter, with duration plus delay at most 320 ms (skeleton and aria-hidden animations are ignored).
   - It also requires `--duration-slow` to be exactly 320ms.
9. **AC-18 layout.**
   - Plan columns are measured from the left edges of the plan `h2` headings (not hidden radios): one column at 360, at least two at 1280.
   - Radios and checkboxes are measured as input plus label union.
   - Visually hidden (≤ 1 px) and `aria-hidden` subtrees are skipped. Everything else interactive must be ≥ 44 × 44, including `Cerrar` and options.
10. **Not automated:** AC-22 and AC-23 (manual per spec), the HC3 phone-keyboard part of AC-12, the screen-reader pass, "no change under `backend/` vs main at 66fc262" (a `git diff` review item, not a test), and `package-lock.json` exactness (only `package.json` is guarded).
11. **Guard strictness beyond the ADR text.** The loose-length list is exactly px, rem, em, ch, vw, vh (dvh, svh and the like are not flagged); `0s` counts as a loose duration. A component CSS may not declare any custom property.
12. **Pure-module specs are uncollectable until implementation.** I could not give per-test counts for the 5 specs that import the missing modules.
13. **In-place router country switching is not supported by the app.** Tests that need both countries use a fresh `TestBed` per country, as the existing AC-22 test does.

- Both are reachable by `<label for>`. While open, `aria-controls` points to the `role="listbox"` and `aria-activedescendant` to the active `role="option"`.
- The popup renders under `document.body`. Selected options have `aria-selected="true"` and an `svg[aria-hidden]` check inside the option.
- No extra `<label>` in the page. The popup listbox is also labelled by the field label, so e2e `field()` now excludes non-input/button elements.
- Polite announcements ("1 opción", "N opciones", "No encontramos opciones para «xyz».") are text in any `[aria-live="polite"]` or `[role="status"]`, either the CDK LiveAnnouncer or the component's own.
- The empty-result text is also visible text in the document.
- Date field: `<input type="text">` with `placeholder="dd/mm/aaaa"`, and "Formato: dd/mm/aaaa" in its `aria-describedby`. A button named "Elegir fecha: <label>" (aria-label or text) follows it directly in the DOM, with `type="button"`.
- Calendar:
  - `role="dialog"` with `aria-modal="true"` and `aria-labelledby` pointing at the visible text "noviembre de 2008".
  - Buttons "Elegir año", "Mes anterior", "Mes siguiente", "Cerrar".
  - `role="grid"`; `role="columnheader"` cells expose the full day names through `aria-label`, `abbr[title]` or text.
  - `role="gridcell"` carries `aria-label="15 de mayo de 1990"`, `aria-selected` and `aria-disabled` itself. Focus sits on the cell or inside it; padding cells are siblings in the same row.
  - The year list is a `role="listbox"` of `role="option"` years with `aria-selected` on the current one.
- Page behind the dialog: the child of `<body>` that holds the page gets `aria-hidden="true"` while open and loses it after.
- Header: a `<header>` or `role="banner"` with the text "Cotizador de seguro de auto", the Strapi country name and an `svg[aria-hidden="true"][focusable="false"]`. No heading, link, button or other focusable element.
- Step indicator: an `ol`, `ul` or `role="list"` named "Progreso de la cotización" with 3 `li`.
  - The current step has `aria-current="step"` on the `li` or an element inside it, and the text "Paso n de 3".
  - Earlier steps contain the text "completado". On the confirmation all three do and nothing has `aria-current`.
  - It holds no focusable element, heading or link.
- Header and indicator must be rendered inside the routed tree, not only in `App`, because the harness hosts the routes.
- `data-country-accent="co|cl"` is set on some element of the document; none for a country with no visuals (document-wide query). Header and indicator are absent on `/` and on the unknown-country page.
- Icons: every `svg` inside `app.root` has `aria-hidden="true"`, no `tabindex`, no `<title>` and no text. Text, number, select and date fields show at least one svg in their field container. The checkbox shows none.
- Unmapped keys must render identical icon markup, different from every mapped key's.
- Plan lists: every `li` of the coverage and benefit lists contains an `svg[aria-hidden]`, and its text is unchanged.
- A click anywhere on a card (description, price, a list item) checks its radio, which stays native.
- Skeletons are `aria-hidden="true"` non-svg elements with no text. There must be more of them while loading than once loaded. The loading text stays a leaf element in a `role="status"` or `aria-live="polite"` region outside the hidden subtree, with `aria-busy` on the container.
- Heading outlines are exactly those of AC-20 (summary: h3 title, then terms body from h4 on).
- Chooser links: text exactly the country name, a flag svg inside (a globe for the Perú fixture), no `aria-label`.
- Tokens (`src/styles/tokens.css`, first in `angular.json` `styles`):
  - Prefixes: `--primitive-`, `--component-`, and the semantic ones of ADR-0010 §1 plus `--delay-` and `--motion-` (from ADR-0013).
  - Required families: `--color-`, `--font-`, `--text-`, `--space-`, `--radius-`, `--shadow-`, `--gradient-`, `--duration-`, `--ease-`, `--z-`, `--breakpoint-`.
  - Names the tests read: `--color-bg`, `--color-surface`, `--color-surface-raised`, `--color-text`, `--color-text-muted`, `--color-error`, `--color-focus`, `--color-border-control`, `--color-country-accent`, `--texture-dots`, `--duration-slow` (320ms).
  - `@font-face` only in `tokens.css`: Archivo `700 800`, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next `400 700`, one `url('/fonts/*.woff2') format('woff2')` each, `swap`.
  - `--font-*` tokens name only those two plus `system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif`.
  - `[data-country-accent='co']` and `='cl'` blocks.
  - Base `--duration-*` and `--delay-*` each set to `0ms` inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`.
- Colour forms in `tokens.css`: `#RRGGBB`, `color-mix(in srgb, #hex N%, transparent)` and `linear-gradient(...)` / `radial-gradient(...)` of those.
- `contrast-pairs.json` is an array of `{ id, fg, bg: string[], min, ac: "US-04-AC-02" }`.
  - A gradient token on either side expands to all its stops. `"texture-worst"` is the dot colour composited over `--color-bg`. `fg: "--color-country-accent"` is evaluated once with the brand default and once per accent block.
  - Required rows: fg `--color-text` and `--color-text-muted` over `--color-bg`, `texture-worst` and `--color-surface`; `--color-error`; `--color-focus` and `--color-border-control` (min 3) over `--color-bg` and `--color-surface`; `--color-country-accent` over bg, surface and `--color-surface-raised`; at least 2 rows over a multi-stop gradient with min ≥ 4.5; at least 1 row whose fg is a gradient with min ≥ 3.
  - Rows for text names may not set `min` below 4.5, nor UI names below 3.
- `index.html` preloads `/fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next*.woff2` (`as="font"`, `type="font/woff2"`, `crossorigin`) and not Archivo, with no `http(s)` URL in the file. `angular.json` `assets` mentions both font packages and an output of `/fonts`.
- `app.routes.ts` has `loadComponent` on `datos` and no static import of `QuoteFormPage`.
- `package.json`: exact versions; names = the pre-US-04 list + `@angular/aria` 22.3.0, `@angular/cdk` 22.3.0 (equal to `@angular/core`), `@lucide/angular` 1.77.0, both `@fontsource-variable/*` 5.3.0; none of `motion`, `gsap`, `@angular/animations`, `@angular/material`, `lucide-angular`, `@ng-icons/*`.

## 5. Existing tests rewritten and why they are not weaker

**Helpers**
- `testing/dom.ts`
  - `allControls()` now selects `input, select, [role="combobox"]`.
  - `shownValue` reads the button text for a select-only and the input value for the rest. `''` for an empty searchable still passes the existing `['', false, PROMPT]` check in AC-22.
  - `choose` and `fillForm` are now async and use the open-then-click-option path of spec §11.1. `fillForm` types dates as dd/mm/aaaa.
  - New: `expectPrompt`, `press`, `typeKeys`, `openCombobox`, `clickOption`, `settleUi`, `listboxOf`, `optionTexts`.
- `seed-fixtures` and `plan-fixtures`: the date inputs are now "15/05/1990" and "20/03/1985". The `*_RAW` stored values are unchanged.
- The three page specs only gain `await` before `fillForm`.

**Component specs**
- All tests keep their titles and AC IDs. Wherever a native select or date was asserted, the new assertion checks what is shown and what is stored (`QuoteStore` or `sessionStorage`).
- AC-01 render test: now also asserts the date is a text box (not a combobox) plus the "Elegir fecha: …" button; the 3 selects are comboboxes with `aria-expanded` false then true and `aria-controls` equal to the rendered listbox.
- AC-07 options: now checks the open listbox contents and order, no selected option, no prompt option, and each of the 4 options stores BOG, MDE, CLO and BAQ (stronger than the old `o.value` list).
- AC-04 hydration and AC-23 stale select: shown value plus stored value (the old test checked only the select value).
- The `badInput` tests for optional and required dates now type real unreadable text ("10/13/2026", "15/05/199") and also assert the text stays visible and the focus is on the date box (new).

**E2E**
- `fillField` uses combobox → click → `getByRole('option', exact)` → assert shown.
- `expectEntered` asserts the shown value and the stored option value (select) or ISO value (date). The `aria-invalid` check is unchanged.
- `expectEmptyStep1`: each combobox shows the prompt (button text, or input `''` plus placeholder) and the stored value for its key is empty.
- The three US-03-AC-11 tests: the select-bearing one uses `expectFieldEmpty`; the two text-only ones are unchanged.
- The R3-F01 tests: no locale override; the date box loses its last digit with End and Backspace; Tab goes until the focus leaves the date field; the message, `aria-invalid`, the stored value not containing "1990-05-15" and the focus on the date are asserted as before, plus the text staying "15/05/199".
- AC-24 keyboard test: type, Enter, shown and stored for all 3 selects and the date; Tab order, Shift+Tab, focus indicators and Enter on "Continuar" are unchanged.
- The leak lists in the three flow tests also forbid "15/05/1990" now (stricter).
- Nothing was skipped, deleted or loosened.

## 6. Ambiguities and decisions for the orchestrator

1. **`parseDateText` return for unreadable text.** The ADR-0012 text says `null`; the task brief says "invalid → `''` with the text kept". I tested the ADR: `null` is unreadable, `''` is blank. The component maps `null` to a stored `''`.
2. **Signatures the ADRs leave open.**
   - `calendar-dates.ts` (locale tag instead of firstDay, ISO strings, `monthGrid` return shape, `firstDayOfWeek(tag, makeLocale?)`) and `iconForField` are mine.
   - The developer may rename, but then the 5 pure specs need updating.
3. **Per-country rows in `contrast-pairs.json`.** The ADR gives no shape. My convention: a row with `fg: "--color-country-accent"` is evaluated per accent block.
4. **Header, indicator and skeleton conventions** are test conventions (section 4). A skeleton "shape" is an `aria-hidden` non-svg empty element, so a decorative empty aria-hidden element on a ready page would count; the test only requires fewer shapes after loading. The spec has no accessible handle for skeletons.
5. **Select-only type-ahead with spaces.** §11.1 says to type "Cédula de c" and press Enter. Space on a select-only combobox chooses the active option when open, so the typed string passes through several choose cycles. It ends on "Cédula de ciudadanía" either way, but it depends on the exact implementation. I kept §11.1 verbatim.
6. **Space on a collapsed searchable.** Asserted as "keydown not default-prevented" in the component test and `toHaveValue(' ')` in e2e. Enter on a searchable input inside a form is asserted to open the list (no submit).
7. **jsdom limits.**
   - Tab does not move focus, so only "Tab commits and closes" is asserted there; the move to "Línea" is e2e.
   - Outside-click is simulated with pointerdown, mousedown, pointerup, mouseup and click.
   - Opening a combobox uses `focus()` + `click()` in the component helper (no ArrowDown fallback), which is exactly AC-05's "activate".
   - Option choice uses `option.click()`; whether `@angular/aria` picks it up in jsdom without a pointerdown is for the developer to prove.
8. **AC-14.**
   - The test requires at least one finite `getAnimations()` entry during the enter, with duration plus delay at most 320 ms (skeleton and aria-hidden animations are ignored).
   - It also requires `--duration-slow` to be exactly 320ms.
9. **AC-18 layout.**
   - Plan columns are measured from the left edges of the plan `h2` headings (not hidden radios): one column at 360, at least two at 1280.
   - Radios and checkboxes are measured as input plus label union.
   - Visually hidden (≤ 1 px) and `aria-hidden` subtrees are skipped. Everything else interactive must be ≥ 44 × 44, including `Cerrar` and options.
10. **Not automated:** AC-22 and AC-23 (manual per spec), the HC3 phone-keyboard part of AC-12, the screen-reader pass, "no change under `backend/` vs main at 66fc262" (a `git diff` review item, not a test), and `package-lock.json` exactness (only `package.json` is guarded).
11. **Guard strictness beyond the ADR text.** The loose-length list is exactly px, rem, em, ch, vw, vh (dvh, svh and the like are not flagged); `0s` counts as a loose duration. A component CSS may not declare any custom property.
12. **Pure-module specs are uncollectable until implementation.** I could not give per-test counts for the 5 specs that import the missing modules.
13. **In-place router country switching is not supported by the app.** Tests that need both countries use a fresh `TestBed` per country, as the existing AC-22 test does.

The tree is clean after the commit. I touched only test files, `frontend/src/testing/**`, `frontend/e2e/**` and `specs/US-04/tasks.md` (T-07..T-15 and the status block). No production file changed.

  - `role="grid"`; `role="columnheader"` cells expose the full day names through `aria-label`, `abbr[title]` or text.
  - `role="gridcell"` carries `aria-label="15 de mayo de 1990"`, `aria-selected` and `aria-disabled` itself. Focus sits on the cell or inside it; padding cells are siblings in the same row.
  - The year list is a `role="listbox"` of `role="option"` years with `aria-selected` on the current one.
- Page behind the dialog: the child of `<body>` that holds the page gets `aria-hidden="true"` while open and loses it after.
- Header: a `<header>` or `role="banner"` with the text "Cotizador de seguro de auto", the Strapi country name and an `svg[aria-hidden="true"][focusable="false"]`. No heading, link, button or other focusable element.
- Step indicator: an `ol`, `ul` or `role="list"` named "Progreso de la cotización" with 3 `li`.
  - The current step has `aria-current="step"` on the `li` or an element inside it, and the text "Paso n de 3".
  - Earlier steps contain the text "completado". On the confirmation all three do and nothing has `aria-current`.
  - It holds no focusable element, heading or link.
- Header and indicator must be rendered inside the routed tree, not only in `App`, because the harness hosts the routes.
- `data-country-accent="co|cl"` is set on some element of the document; none for a country with no visuals (document-wide query). Header and indicator are absent on `/` and on the unknown-country page.
- Icons: every `svg` inside `app.root` has `aria-hidden="true"`, no `tabindex`, no `<title>` and no text. Text, number, select and date fields show at least one svg in their field container. The checkbox shows none.
- Unmapped keys must render identical icon markup, different from every mapped key's.
- Plan lists: every `li` of the coverage and benefit lists contains an `svg[aria-hidden]`, and its text is unchanged.
- A click anywhere on a card (description, price, a list item) checks its radio, which stays native.
- Skeletons are `aria-hidden="true"` non-svg elements with no text. There must be more of them while loading than once loaded. The loading text stays a leaf element in a `role="status"` or `aria-live="polite"` region outside the hidden subtree, with `aria-busy` on the container.
- Heading outlines are exactly those of AC-20 (summary: h3 title, then terms body from h4 on).
- Chooser links: text exactly the country name, a flag svg inside (a globe for the Perú fixture), no `aria-label`.
- Tokens (`src/styles/tokens.css`, first in `angular.json` `styles`):
  - Prefixes: `--primitive-`, `--component-`, and the semantic ones of ADR-0010 §1 plus `--delay-` and `--motion-` (from ADR-0013).
  - Required families: `--color-`, `--font-`, `--text-`, `--space-`, `--radius-`, `--shadow-`, `--gradient-`, `--duration-`, `--ease-`, `--z-`, `--breakpoint-`.
  - Names the tests read: `--color-bg`, `--color-surface`, `--color-surface-raised`, `--color-text`, `--color-text-muted`, `--color-error`, `--color-focus`, `--color-border-control`, `--color-country-accent`, `--texture-dots`, `--duration-slow` (320ms).
  - `@font-face` only in `tokens.css`: Archivo `700 800`, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next `400 700`, one `url('/fonts/*.woff2') format('woff2')` each, `swap`.
  - `--font-*` tokens name only those two plus `system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif`.
  - `[data-country-accent='co']` and `='cl'` blocks.
  - Base `--duration-*` and `--delay-*` each set to `0ms` inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`.
- Colour forms in `tokens.css`: `#RRGGBB`, `color-mix(in srgb, #hex N%, transparent)` and `linear-gradient(...)` / `radial-gradient(...)` of those.
- `contrast-pairs.json` is an array of `{ id, fg, bg: string[], min, ac: "US-04-AC-02" }`.
  - A gradient token on either side expands to all its stops. `"texture-worst"` is the dot colour composited over `--color-bg`. `fg: "--color-country-accent"` is evaluated once with the brand default and once per accent block.
  - Required rows: fg `--color-text` and `--color-text-muted` over `--color-bg`, `texture-worst` and `--color-surface`; `--color-error`; `--color-focus` and `--color-border-control` (min 3) over `--color-bg` and `--color-surface`; `--color-country-accent` over bg, surface and `--color-surface-raised`; at least 2 rows over a multi-stop gradient with min ≥ 4.5; at least 1 row whose fg is a gradient with min ≥ 3.
  - Rows for text names may not set `min` below 4.5, nor UI names below 3.
- `index.html` preloads `/fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next*.woff2` (`as="font"`, `type="font/woff2"`, `crossorigin`) and not Archivo, with no `http(s)` URL in the file. `angular.json` `assets` mentions both font packages and an output of `/fonts`.
- `app.routes.ts` has `loadComponent` on `datos` and no static import of `QuoteFormPage`.
- `package.json`: exact versions; names = the pre-US-04 list + `@angular/aria` 22.3.0, `@angular/cdk` 22.3.0 (equal to `@angular/core`), `@lucide/angular` 1.77.0, both `@fontsource-variable/*` 5.3.0; none of `motion`, `gsap`, `@angular/animations`, `@angular/material`, `lucide-angular`, `@ng-icons/*`.

## 5. Existing tests rewritten and why they are not weaker

**Helpers**
- `testing/dom.ts`
  - `allControls()` now selects `input, select, [role="combobox"]`.
  - `shownValue` reads the button text for a select-only and the input value for the rest. `''` for an empty searchable still passes the existing `['', false, PROMPT]` check in AC-22.
  - `choose` and `fillForm` are now async and use the open-then-click-option path of spec §11.1. `fillForm` types dates as dd/mm/aaaa.
  - New: `expectPrompt`, `press`, `typeKeys`, `openCombobox`, `clickOption`, `settleUi`, `listboxOf`, `optionTexts`.
- `seed-fixtures` and `plan-fixtures`: the date inputs are now "15/05/1990" and "20/03/1985". The `*_RAW` stored values are unchanged.
- The three page specs only gain `await` before `fillForm`.

**Component specs**
- All tests keep their titles and AC IDs. Wherever a native select or date was asserted, the new assertion checks what is shown and what is stored (`QuoteStore` or `sessionStorage`).
- AC-01 render test: now also asserts the date is a text box (not a combobox) plus the "Elegir fecha: …" button; the 3 selects are comboboxes with `aria-expanded` false then true and `aria-controls` equal to the rendered listbox.
- AC-07 options: now checks the open listbox contents and order, no selected option, no prompt option, and each of the 4 options stores BOG, MDE, CLO and BAQ (stronger than the old `o.value` list).
- AC-04 hydration and AC-23 stale select: shown value plus stored value (the old test checked only the select value).
- The `badInput` tests for optional and required dates now type real unreadable text ("10/13/2026", "15/05/199") and also assert the text stays visible and the focus is on the date box (new).

**E2E**
- `fillField` uses combobox → click → `getByRole('option', exact)` → assert shown.
- `expectEntered` asserts the shown value and the stored option value (select) or ISO value (date). The `aria-invalid` check is unchanged.
- `expectEmptyStep1`: each combobox shows the prompt (button text, or input `''` plus placeholder) and the stored value for its key is empty.
- The three US-03-AC-11 tests: the select-bearing one uses `expectFieldEmpty`; the two text-only ones are unchanged.
- The R3-F01 tests: no locale override; the date box loses its last digit with End and Backspace; Tab goes until the focus leaves the date field; the message, `aria-invalid`, the stored value not containing "1990-05-15" and the focus on the date are asserted as before, plus the text staying "15/05/199".
- AC-24 keyboard test: type, Enter, shown and stored for all 3 selects and the date; Tab order, Shift+Tab, focus indicators and Enter on "Continuar" are unchanged.
- The leak lists in the three flow tests also forbid "15/05/1990" now (stricter).
- Nothing was skipped, deleted or loosened.

## 6. Ambiguities and decisions for the orchestrator

1. **`parseDateText` return for unreadable text.** The ADR-0012 text says `null`; the task brief says "invalid → `''` with the text kept". I tested the ADR: `null` is unreadable, `''` is blank. The component maps `null` to a stored `''`.
2. **Signatures the ADRs leave open.**
   - `calendar-dates.ts` (locale tag instead of firstDay, ISO strings, `monthGrid` return shape, `firstDayOfWeek(tag, makeLocale?)`) and `iconForField` are mine.
   - The developer may rename, but then the 5 pure specs need updating.
3. **Per-country rows in `contrast-pairs.json`.** The ADR gives no shape. My convention: a row with `fg: "--color-country-accent"` is evaluated per accent block.
4. **Header, indicator and skeleton conventions** are test conventions (section 4). A skeleton "shape" is an `aria-hidden` non-svg empty element, so a decorative empty aria-hidden element on a ready page would count; the test only requires fewer shapes after loading. The spec has no accessible handle for skeletons.
5. **Select-only type-ahead with spaces.** §11.1 says to type "Cédula de c" and press Enter. Space on a select-only combobox chooses the active option when open, so the typed string passes through several choose cycles. It ends on "Cédula de ciudadanía" either way, but it depends on the exact implementation. I kept §11.1 verbatim.
6. **Space on a collapsed searchable.** Asserted as "keydown not default-prevented" in the component test and `toHaveValue(' ')` in e2e. Enter on a searchable input inside a form is asserted to open the list (no submit).
7. **jsdom limits.**
   - Tab does not move focus, so only "Tab commits and closes" is asserted there; the move to "Línea" is e2e.
   - Outside-click is simulated with pointerdown, mousedown, pointerup, mouseup and click.
   - Opening a combobox uses `focus()` + `click()` in the component helper (no ArrowDown fallback), which is exactly AC-05's "activate".
   - Option choice uses `option.click()`; whether `@angular/aria` picks it up in jsdom without a pointerdown is for the developer to prove.
8. **AC-14.**
   - The test requires at least one finite `getAnimations()` entry during the enter, with duration plus delay at most 320 ms (skeleton and aria-hidden animations are ignored).
   - It also requires `--duration-slow` to be exactly 320ms.
9. **AC-18 layout.**
   - Plan columns are measured from the left edges of the plan `h2` headings (not hidden radios): one column at 360, at least two at 1280.
   - Radios and checkboxes are measured as input plus label union.
   - Visually hidden (≤ 1 px) and `aria-hidden` subtrees are skipped. Everything else interactive must be ≥ 44 × 44, including `Cerrar` and options.
10. **Not automated:** AC-22 and AC-23 (manual per spec), the HC3 phone-keyboard part of AC-12, the screen-reader pass, "no change under `backend/` vs main at 66fc262" (a `git diff` review item, not a test), and `package-lock.json` exactness (only `package.json` is guarded).
11. **Guard strictness beyond the ADR text.** The loose-length list is exactly px, rem, em, ch, vw, vh (dvh, svh and the like are not flagged); `0s` counts as a loose duration. A component CSS may not declare any custom property.
12. **Pure-module specs are uncollectable until implementation.** I could not give per-test counts for the 5 specs that import the missing modules.
13. **In-place router country switching is not supported by the app.** Tests that need both countries use a fresh `TestBed` per country, as the existing AC-22 test does.

message.content:
The coordinator sent a message while you were working:
US-04 review round 1 (`reviews/US-04-review-R1.md`, commit e489301) is CHANGES REQUESTED. The human decided (Gate history in specs/US-04/tasks.md): restore the approved design for F03/F04 and adapt the tests; fix F01, F02, F05, F06, F07, F08; F09 stays (HC3). Write the tests first (red where the fix is not in yet), then commit. Touch only test files (and `frontend/src/testing/**`, `frontend/e2e/**`); not production code, not tasks.md. Read the report for each finding's evidence.

- **F01** (select field icons painted over by the select's own background): add a test that fails while an icon is covered — the icon must be the topmost element at its centre (e2e `elementFromPoint` on each field's icon centre for every field type, both countries), not just present in the DOM.
- **F02** (plan radio ring ~2.4:1 on the recommended panel; browser-drawn): require the radio ring/indicator to be drawn from tokens and covered by `contrast-pairs.json` over every plan surface incl. the recommended gradient stops (≥ 3:1), e.g. extend the contrast spec's required rows and add a component/e2e check that the radio uses the token colours (computed style), not the UA default.
- **F03** (restore the ADR-0013 sheet slide): the AC-12 e2e must wait for the sheet's animation to finish (`getAnimations()` settled / `animationend`) before measuring the box, and still assert full width and bottom edge at the viewport bottom; under reduced motion it must be immediate. The test must pass with a `translateY` slide.
- **F04** (restore the plan `h1` focus on arrival): component test that the `h1` has focus on arrival **before** the plans load (US-02 §8 Arrival); the US-02-AC-16 e2e (and any other) must wait for the plans to be shown before pressing Tab, instead of relying on the delayed focus.
- **F05**: the `disableAnimations: true` guard must ignore comments and strings in comments; add a self-test fixture where the only `disableAnimations: true` is in a comment and the call has `disableAnimations: false` → the guard reports it.
- **F06**: (a) no Ctrl+A override — Ctrl/Cmd+A must keep the platform default (assert the handler does not `preventDefault` it); (b) remove the reliance on the `detail === 0` hack: fix `choose()` in `testing/dom.ts` so it does not re-open an already open list, and add a test that a click on an open select-only list closes it (real behaviour in Chromium per the review); (c) if you can express it, a test that keydown/click do not trigger a global change detection on unrelated components is optional — skip if not testable cleanly and say so.

### US-04-R1-F01 — Select fields show no field icon (major)

`quote-form.html:23-25` renders `<span class="control__icon">` before the control, positioned
absolutely with `z-index: var(--z-base)` (= 0, `quote-form.css:20-28`). Text, number and date
controls are not positioned, so the icon paints above them. `app-custom-select` has
`:host { position: relative; }` (`custom-select.css:1-4`) and comes **after** the icon in tree order
in the same stacking context. Positioned boxes with `z-index: auto`/`0` paint in tree order, so the
select's own background (`--component-input-bg`) covers the icon. The select still gets
`input--icon`, so its text is indented past an empty slot.

Evidence (own script, 1280 × 800, `/co/datos`, clip screenshot of each `.control__icon` box,
brightest pixel): "Tipo de documento" 33, "Ciudad" 33, "Marca" 33 (the input background); every
other field 193 (the icon). `nextElementSibling` position: `app-custom-select` → `relative`,
everything else `static`. Same in `docs/qa/US-04/after/01-datos-*` and `01b-*`, both countries.

Why the tests pass: `field-icons.spec.ts` checks the map, and the AC-04 block of
`quote-form-page.spec.ts` checks that the `svg` is in the DOM and `aria-hidden`. jsdom does no
painting, and the e2e suite does not look. AC-04 says the field "shows the icon"; the AC-04 note
("the test asserts the mapping table, not pixels") limits what the unit test proves, not what the
feature must do.

Expected: all nine mapped icons (and the default) visible inside their controls. Suggested
direction: a stacking order for the icon above the control (a `--z-` token, not a literal), or
render the icon inside `CustomSelect`/`DateField`. Add a check that would fail today, for example an
e2e that compares the icon box of each field against the control background (note:
`elementFromPoint` skips the icon because of `pointer-events: none`, so it cannot be used).

### US-04-R1-F02 — Plan radio boundary below 3:1 on the recommended card (major)

The plan radio stays native (spec §2) and is styled only with `accent-color`. Under
`color-scheme: dark`, Chromium draws an unchecked radio as a `#3B3B3B` disc with a thin `#858585`
ring (measured at device scale 4 on the running app, `radio-basic`/`radio-recommended` crops;
computed `appearance: auto`). Contrast with WCAG 2.x luminance:

| Where | Ring `#858585` | Fill `#3B3B3B` |
|---|---|---|
| Plain plan card `#14131E` | ≈ 5.0:1 (passes) | ≈ 1.6:1 |
| Recommended card at the radio (`#5B22B5` sampled; token top stop `#6427C4`) | **≈ 2.4:1 (fails 3:1)** | ≈ 1.3:1 |

The consent and terms checkboxes use the same UA ring on `#0B0B14`, ≈ 5.3:1, so they pass. The
checked radio (`#D5C7FF` dot) is clearly distinct.

So on the recommended plan, the one card the brief makes loudest, the control that people choose
with has a boundary below the 3:1 that US-04-BR-02 and the AC-02 row "input and interactive card
border" require for controls. The orchestrator's "dark grey on dark" impression comes from the fill
(1.3–1.6:1); on plain cards the ring passes. No test can catch this: `contrast-pairs.json` lists only
token pairs, and the radio colours come from the browser, not from `tokens.css`.

Expected: every control boundary ≥ 3:1 against its real background, including the recommended
gradient at every stop. Suggested direction: draw the radio from tokens (for example
`appearance: none` with a token border and dot, which keeps the native semantics), then add rows
such as "radio border on `--color-surface` and on `--gradient-plan-recommended`" to
`contrast-pairs.json`. Check the forced-colors fallback if `appearance` changes.

### US-04-R1-F03 — Bottom sheets fade instead of the ADR-0013 slide (minor)

ADR-0013 §2 (Accepted) decides: "Bottom sheet open | `animate.enter` on the sheet |
translateY(100%) → 0". The branch uses an opacity fade for both sheets. The CSS comment gives the
reason: "it fades in and never slides, so its box is its final box from the first frame". That is
the AC-12 e2e reading the sheet box right after opening (verified: with motion allowed, opacity
0.597 at +30 ms and the box already final). This is the US-03-R1-F03 pattern again: production
motion was changed to fit the timing of a test. Users get no harm (and a fade is gentler), so it is
minor. But it is an unrecorded deviation from an accepted ADR.

Expected, one of: (a) restore the slide and make the AC-12 test wait for the sheet's animations to
finish (for example `Promise.all(el.getAnimations().map(a => a.finished))`) before measuring, or
(b) keep the fade and record it as an ADR-0013 implementation note in `adr/README.md` that the human
accepts. This cannot be closed as "won't fix" without (b).

### US-04-R1-F04 — Plan heading focused only after the plans load (minor)

Before (main): `afterNextRender(() => heading.focus())` on arrival, unless the load had failed. Now
(`plan-list-page.ts:58-62`) an `effect` waits for a status other than `loading`/`error`. Measured
after "Continuar" on step 1: `activeElement` is `BODY` with 0 plans in the DOM, then `H1` about 50 ms
later (local stack, warm cache). On a slow network (the plan request has a 10 s timeout), keyboard and
screen-reader users have no focus anchor while "Cargando planes…" is shown. US-02 §8 *Arrival* says
"Focus on the h1" on navigation, and US-04-BR-09 says "focus on the arriving h1 as today". The
commit gives no rationale. The likely driver is the US-02-AC-16 e2e (heading focused, then Tab must
reach the plan group, `us-01-03-full-flow-co.spec.ts:249-306`): while the plans load, Tab from the
`h1` reaches "Atrás". That is the e2e driving a behaviour change again.

Arguably this is a reasonable UX choice (the user hears the heading when the plans are there), but it
belongs to the human. Expected: revert to focus on arrival and make the test wait for the plan
group before pressing Tab; or keep it, record it (ADR-0001 implementation note or a US-02 Review log
row, with the human's decision), and add a test for focus during loading.

### US-04-R1-F05 — The `disableAnimations` guard counts comments (minor)

`cdkAnimationUse()` (`design-guards.ts:244-248`) counts call sites and `disableAnimations: true`
matches in the raw source text. `panel-overlay.ts` has the phrase in its doc comment (line 16) and in
the code (line 45). Mutation on a copy: `disableAnimations: false` at line 45 →
`design-guards.spec.ts` "every CDK overlay and dialog is created with disableAnimations: true"
**still passes** (other mutations in the same run were caught). The runtime AC-17 e2e would not catch
it at desktop size either: the select popover has no backdrop, so the CDK 1 ms backdrop transition
only appears with the sheet. Expected: strip comments before matching, or match
`disableAnimations` inside each call's options object, and add a self-test row with a commented-out
`disableAnimations: true` next to a `false`.

### US-04-R1-F06 — Select tweaks to justify or remove (minor)

The brief asked to check these frontend-developer tweaks; three need action:

1. **Click with `detail === 0`** (`custom-select.ts:152-164`). The comment says such a click "only
   ever opens the list, so activating an open select leaves it open". In Chromium it does not: with
   the list open, `el.click()` (detail 0) and a synthetic `MouseEvent('click', { detail: 0 })` both
   **close** it (closed → open → closed in my probe). The only caller that relies on it is the jsdom
   helper `openCombobox()` (`testing/dom.ts:131-133`, `combo.click()`). Either make the claim true
   and test it in e2e, or drop the handler and fix the comment. Assistive technology that activates a
   control with a detail-0 click toggles it, which is acceptable; a wrong comment is not.
2. **Ctrl+A** (`custom-select.ts:172-177`). Select-all on Ctrl+A is not in the spec (§8.1, AC-06/07
   list no such key), and no test uses it (`grep` finds none). On Windows and Linux the browser
   already does this. On macOS, Ctrl+A is the standard "move to line start" text key, so the tweak
